path: string,\n    expectedStatusCode: number,\n): Promise<string> {\n    const response = await request.get(path, { maxRedirects: 0 });\n\n    expect(response.status(), `Expected ${path} to answer with status ${expectedStatusCode}`).toBe(expectedStatusCode);\n\n    const locationHeader = response.headers()['location'];\n    expect(locationHeader, `Expected ${path} to name where it redirects`).toBeDefined();\n\n    return readRedirectDestinationPath(locationHeader, response.url());\n}\n\nfor (const path of PUBLIC_PAGE_PATHS) {\n    // Next.js compiles a route on its first dev-server visit. Isolating every route keeps earlier cold compilations\n    // from exhausting the timeout of a healthy page later in the smoke suite.\n    test(`public landing and information page loads: ${path}`, async ({ page }) => {\n        await expectPublicPageToLoad(page, path);\n    });\n}\n\ntest('AI ta Krajta collaboration section deep-links to its media kit', async ({ page }) => {\n    await page.goto(AI_TA_KRAJTA_PATH, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });\n\n    const mediaKitLink = page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Otevřít media kit' });\n    await expect(mediaKitLink).toHaveAttribute('href', AI_TA_KRAJTA_MEDIA_KIT_PATH);\n    await mediaKitLink.click();\n\n    await expect(page).toHaveURL(AI_TA_KRAJTA_MEDIA_KIT_PATH);\n    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: /Oslovte české a slovenské publikum/i })).toBeVisible();\n});\n\ntest('AI ta Krajta owns its metadata, icon and installable manifest and credits Promptbook coder', async ({ page }) => {\n    await page.goto(AI_TA_KRAJTA_PATH, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });\n    await expect(page.locator('footer')).toBeVisible();\n    await expect(page).toHaveTitle(`${AI_TA_KRAJTA_BRAND_NAME} | Český podcast o umělé inteligenci`);\n\n    const metadataIdentity = await page.evaluate(\n        ({ scalableIconPath, rasterIconPath, manifestPath, rssFeedMediaType, rssFeedUrl, rssFeedLabel }) => {\n            const identityTags = Array.from(document.head.querySelectorAll('meta, link'));\n            const structuredDataNodes = Array.from(document.head.querySelectorAll('script[type*=ld]'));\n            const footerText = document.querySelector('footer')?.textContent ?? '';\n\n            const isPromptbookIdentityAbsent = identityTags\n                .filter((element) => /application-name|creator|publisher|og:site_name|twitter:site/.test(element.outerHTML))\n                .every((element) => !element.outerHTML.includes('Promptbook'));\n            const isPromptbookStructuredDataAbsent = structuredDataNodes.every(\n                (element) => !(element.textContent ?? '').includes('Promptbook'),\n            );\n            const isPodcastIconUsed = identityTags.some(\n                (element) =>\n                    element.getAttribute('rel') === 'icon' && element.getAttribute('href') === scalableIconPath,\n            );\n            const isPodcastTouchIconUsed = identityTags.some(\n                (element) =>\n                    element.getAttribute('rel') === 'apple-touch-icon' &&\n                    element.getAttribute('href') === rasterIconPath,\n            );\n            const isPodcastManifestUsed = identityTags.some(\n                (element) => element.getAttribute('rel') === 'manifest' && element.getAttribute('href') === manifestPath,\n            );\n            const isPodcastRssFeedAdvertised = identityTags.some(\n                (element) =>\n                    element.getAttribute('rel') === 'alternate' &&\n                    element.getAttribute('type') === rssFeedMediaType &&\n                    element.getAttribute('href') === rssFeedUrl,\n            );\n            const isPodcastRssFeedLinked = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a')).some(\n                (element) => element.textContent?.trim() === rssFeedLabel && element.getAttribute('href') === rssFeedUrl,\n            );\n            const isLegalCompanyPresent = footerText.includes('AI Web s.r.o.');\n\n            return {\n                isPromptbookIdentityAbsent,\n                isPromptbookStructuredDataAbsent,\n                isPodcastIconUsed,\n                isPodcastTouchIconUsed,\n                isPodcastManifestUsed,\n                isPodcastRssFeedAdvertised,\n                isPodcastRssFeedLinked,\n                isLegalCompanyPresent,\n            };\n        },\n        {\n            scalableIconPath: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.SCALABLE.path,\n            rasterIconPath: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.RASTER.path,\n            manifestPath: AI_TA_KRAJTA_MANIFEST_PATH,\n            rssFeedMediaType: AI_TA_KRAJTA_RSS_FEED_MEDIA_TYPE,\n            rssFeedUrl: AI_TA_KRAJTA_RSS_FEED_PLATFORM.url,\n            rssFeedLabel: AI_TA_KRAJTA_RSS_FEED_PLATFORM.label,\n        },\n    );\n\n    expect(metadataIdentity).toEqual({\n        isPromptbookIdentityAbsent: true,\n        isPromptbookStructuredDataAbsent: true,\n        isPodcastIconUsed: true,\n        isPodcastTouchIconUsed: true,\n        isPodcastManifestUsed: true,\n        isPodcastRssFeedAdvertised: true,\n        isPodcastRssFeedLinked: true,\n        isLegalCompanyPresent: true,\n    });\n\n    await expect(page.locator('footer').getByRole('link', { name: 'Done by Promptbook coder', exact: true }))\n        .toHaveAttribute('href', 'https://coder.ptbk.io/');\n\n    const manifestResponse = await page.request.get(AI_TA_KRAJTA_MANIFEST_PATH);\n\n    expect(manifestResponse.ok()).toBeTruthy();\n    expect(await manifestResponse.json()).toMatchObject({\n        name: AI_TA_KRAJTA_BRAND_NAME,\n        short_name: AI_TA_KRAJTA_BRAND_NAME,\n        icons: [\n            { src: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.SCALABLE.path, purpose: 'any' },\n            { src: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.RASTER.path, purpose: 'any' },\n            { src: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.RASTER.path, purpose: 'maskable' },\n        ],\n    });\n\n    for (const appIcon of [AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.SCALABLE, AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.RASTER]) {\n        const iconResponse = await page.request.get(appIcon.path);\n\n        expect(iconResponse.ok(), `Expected ${appIcon.path} to be served`).toBeTruthy();\n        expect(iconResponse.headers()['content-type']).toContain(appIcon.type);\n    }\n});\n\ntest('AI ta Krajta searches complete transcripts on the server without sending them to the browser', async ({ page, request }) => {\n    const transcriptSearchResponse = await request.get(\n        `${AI_TA_KRAJTA_EPISODE_SEARCH_API_PATH}?${new URLSearchParams({ search: 'zahradníkem' }).toString()}`,\n    );\n    const transcriptSearchResponseText = await transcriptSearchResponse.text();\n\n    expect(transcriptSearchResponse.ok()).toBeTruthy();\n    expect(JSON.parse(transcriptSearchResponseText)).toMatchObject({ episodeSlugs: expect.arrayContaining(['65']) });\n    expect(transcriptSearchResponseText).not.toContain('Kozel za hradníkem');\n\n    await page.goto(AI_TA_KRAJTA_PATH, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });\n    await page.getByRole('searchbox', { name: 'Hledat v dílech' }).fill('zahradníkem');\n\n    await '/pro-mesta',\n    '/for-agro',\n    '/for-industry',\n    '/ai-supervize',\n    AI_SUPERVIZE_MINI_PATH,\n    // '/ai-supervize-mini',\n    '/ai-ta-krajta',\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_MEDIA_KIT_PATH,\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_BRANDING_PATH,\n    '/hackathon-factory',\n    '/cs/online-workshop',\n    '/cs/komunita/clenstvi',\n    '/cs/pavol',\n    '/en/pavol',\n    '/cs/ochrana-osobnich-udaju',\n (typeof PUBLIC_PAGE_PATHS)[number];\n\n/**\n * The address which used to hold the training and now only forwards to the workshop it became\n */\nconst RETIRED_TRAINING_PATH = '/skoleni';\n\n/**\n * A   { path: '/', statusCode: TEMPORARY_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE, destinationPaths: ['/cs', '/en'] },\n    { path: '/pavol', statusCode: TEMPORARY_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE, destinationPaths: ['/cs/pavol', '/en/pavol'] },\n    {\n        path: '/privacy',\n        statusCode: TEMPORARY_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE,\n        destinationPaths: ['/cs/ochrana-osobnich-udaju', '/en/privacy-policy'],\n    },\n    {\n        path: '/terms',\n        statusCode: TEMPORARY_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE,\n        destinationPaths: ['/cs/obchodni-podminky', '/en/terms-and-conditions'],\n    },\n    {\n        path: RETIRED_TRAINING_PATH,\n        statusCode: PERMANENT_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE,\n        destinationPaths: [AI_SUPERVIZE_MINI_PATH],\n    },\n];\n\nconst E2E_DISCOUNT_CODE = 'E2E SLEVA';\n\nconst PUBLIC_PAGE_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 180_000;\n\nasync function expectPublicPageToLoad(page: Page, path: PublicPagePath): Promise<void> {\n    const response = await page.goto(path, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });\n\n    expect(response, `Expected ${path} to produce a document response`).not.toBeNull();\n    expect(response!.ok(), `Expected ${path} to load without a server error`).toBeTruthy();\n    await expect(\n        page.locator('main, h1, footer').first(),\n        `Expected ${path} to render visible page content`,\n    ).toBeVisible();\n}\n\n/**\n * Reads where a redirect points, whether it answers with an absolute or a site-relative `Location`.\n */\nfunction readRedirectDestinationPath(locationHeader: string, requestUrl: string): string {\n    const destinationUrl = new URL(locationHeader, requestUrl);\n\n    return `${destinationUrl.pathname}${destinationUrl.search}${destinationUrl.hash}`;\n}\n\n/**\n * Asks a redirecting address where it points without following it, so the destination is rendered once by the page\n * check which owns it instead of a second time through every address leading to it.\n */\nasync function readRedirectDestination(\n    request: APIRequestContext,\n    path: string,\n    expectedStatusCode: number,\n): Promise<string> {\n    const response = await request.get(path, { maxRedirects: 0 });\n\n    expect(response.status(), `Expected ${path} to answer with status ${expectedStatusCode}`).toBe(expectedStatusCode);\n\n    const locationHeader = response.headers()['location'];\n    expect(locationHeader, `Expected ${path} to name where it redirects`).toBeDefined();\n\n    return readRedirectDestinationPath(locationHeader, response.url());\n}\n\nfor (const path of PUBLIC_PAGE_PATHS) {\n    // Next.js compiles a route on its first dev-server visit. Isolating every route keeps earlier cold compilations\n    // from exhausting the timeout of a healthy page later in the smoke suite.\n    test(`public landing and information page loads: ${path}`, async ({ page }) => {\n        await expectPublicPageToLoad(page, path);\n    });\n}\n\ntest('AI ta Krajta collaboration section deep-links to its media kit', async ({ page }) => {\n    await page.goto(AI_TA_KRAJTA_PATH, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });\n\n    const mediaKitLink = page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Otevřít media kit' });\n    await expect(mediaKitLink).toHaveAttribute('href', AI_TA_KRAJTA_MEDIA_KIT_PATH);\n    await mediaKitLink.click();\n\n    await expect(page).toHaveURL(AI_TA_KRAJTA_MEDIA_KIT_PATH);\n    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: /Oslovte české a slovenské publikum/i })).toBeVisible();\n});\n\ntest('AI ta Krajta owns its metadata, icon and installable manifest and credits Promptbook coder', async ({ page }) => {\n    await page.goto(AI_TA_KRAJTA_PATH, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });\n    await expect(page.locator('footer')).toBeVisible();\n    await expect(page).toHaveTitle(`${AI_TA_KRAJTA_BRAND_NAME} | Český podcast o umělé inteligenci`);\n\n    const metadataIdentity = await page.evaluate(\n        ({ scalableIconPath, rasterIconPath, manifestPath, rssFeedMediaType, rssFeedUrl, rssFeedLabel }) => {\n            const identityTags = Array.from(document.head.querySelectorAll('meta, link'));\n            const structuredDataNodes = Array.from(document.head.querySelectorAll('script[type*=ld]'));\n            const footerText = document.querySelector('footer')?.textContent ?? '';\n\n            const isPromptbookIdentityAbsent = identityTags\n                .filter((element) => /application-name|creator|publisher|og:site_name|twitter:site/.test(element.outerHTML))\n                .every((element) => !element.outerHTML.includes('Promptbook'));\n            const isPromptbookStructuredDataAbsent = structuredDataNodes.every(\n                (element) => !(element.textContent ?? element.getAttribute('href') === scalableIconPath,\n            );\n            const isPodcastTouchIconUsed = identityTags.some(\n                (element) =>\n                    element.getAttribute('rel') === 'apple-touch-icon' &&\n                    element.getAttribute('href') === rasterIconPath,\n            );\n            const isPodcastManifestUsed = identityTags.some(\n                (element) => element.getAttribute('rel') === 'manifest' && element.getAttribute('href') === manifestPath,\n            );\n            const isPodcastRssFeedAdvertised = identityTags.some(\n                (element) =>\n                    element.getAttribute('rel') === 'alternate' &&\n                    element.getAttribute('type') ===            (element) => element.textContent?.trim() === rssFeedLabel && element.getAttribute('href') === rssFeedUrl,\n            );\n            const isLegalCompanyPresent = footerText.includes('AI isPodcastTouchIconUsed,\n                isPodcastManifestUsed,\n                isPodcastRssFeedAdvertised,\n                isPodcastRssFeedLinked,\n                isLegalCompanyPresent,\n            };\n        },\n        {\n            scalableIconPath: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.SCALABLE.path,\n            rasterIconPath: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.RASTER.path,\n            manifestPath: AI_TA_KRAJTA_MANIFEST_PATH,\n            rssFeedMediaType: AI_TA_KRAJTA_RSS_FEED_MEDIA_TYPE,\n            rssFeedUrl: AI_TA_KRAJTA_RSS_FEED_PLATFORM.url,\n            rssFeedLabel: AI_TA_KRAJTA_RSS_FEED_PLATFORM.label,\n        },\n    );\n\n    expect(metadataIdentity).toEqual({\n        isPromptbookIdentityAbsent: true,\n        isPromptbookStructuredDataAbsent: true,\n        isPodcastIconUsed: true,\n        isPodcastTouchIconUsed: true,\n        isPodcastManifestUsed: true,\n        isPodcastRssFeedAdvertised: true,\n        isPodcastRssFeedLinked: true,\n        isLegalCompanyPresent: true,\n    });\n\n    await expect(page.locator('footer').getByRole('link', { name: 'Done by Promptbook coder', exact: true }))\n        .toHaveAttribute('href', 'https://coder.ptbk.io/');\n\n    const manifestResponse = await page.request.get(AI_TA_KRAJTA_MANIFEST_PATH);\n\n    expect(manifestResponse.ok()).toBeTruthy();\n    expect(await manifestResponse.json()).toMatchObject({\n        name: AI_TA_KRAJTA_BRAND_NAME,\n        short_name: AI_TA_KRAJTA_BRAND_NAME,\n        icons: [\n            { src: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.SCALABLE.path, purpose: 'any' },\n            { src: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.RASTER.path, purpose: 'any' },\n            { src: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.RASTER.path, purpose: 'maskable' },\n        ],\n    });\n\n    for (const appIcon of [AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.SCALABLE, AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.RASTER]) {\n        const iconResponse = await page.request.get(appIcon.path);\n\n        expect(iconResponse.ok(), `Expected ${appIcon.path} to be served`).toBeTruthy();\n        expect(iconResponse.headers()['content-type']).toContain(appIcon.type);\n    }\n});\n\ntest('AI ta Krajta searches complete transcripts on the server without sending them to the browser', async ({ page, request }) => {\n    const transcriptSearchResponse = await request.get(\n        `${AI_TA_KRAJTA_EPISODE_SEARCH_API_PATH}?${new URLSearchParams({ search: 'zahradníkem' }).toString()}`,\n    );\n    const transcriptSearchResponseText = await transcriptSearchResponse.text();\n\n    expect(transcriptSearchResponse.ok()).toBeTruthy();\n    expect(JSON.parse(transcriptSearchResponseText)).toMatchObject({ episodeSlugs: expect.arrayContaining(['65']) });\n    expect(transcriptSearchResponseText).not.toContain('Kozel za hradníkem');\n\n    await page.goto(AI_TA_KRAJTA_PATH, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });\n    await page.getByRole('searchbox', { name: 'Hledat v dílech' }).fill('zahradníkem');\n\n    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: /AI zrychlí vývoj 10x/ })).toBeVisible();\n    await expect(page.locator('body')).not.toContainText('Kozel za hradníkem');\n});\n\nfor (const publicRedirect of ${destinationPath}`,\n        ).toBeTruthy();\n    });\n}\n\ntest(`${RETIRED_TRAINING_PATH} carries a discount code to the workshop registration`, async ({ request }) => {\n    test.setTimeout(PUBLIC_PAGE_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS);\n\n    const destinationPath = await readRedirectDestination(\n        request,\n        `${RETIRED_TRAINING_PATH}?${DISCOUNT_CODE_QUERY_PARAMETER}=${encodeURIComponent(E2E_DISCOUNT_CODE)}`,\n        PERMANENT_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE,\n    );\n\n    expect(destinationPath, `Expected ${RETIRED_TRAINING_PATH} to pre-fill the discount code it was given`).toBe(\n        createDiscountCodePrefillPath(AI_SUPERVIZE_MINI_PATH, REGISTRATION_SECTION_ID, E2E_DISCOUNT_CODE),\n    );\n});\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":20,"oldLines":6,"newStart":20,"newLines":7,"lines":[" const PUBLIC_PAGE_PATHS = [","     '/cs',","     '/en',","+    PRO_FIRMY_PATH,","     '/pro-mesta',","   };\n        },\n        {\n            scalableIconPath: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.SCALABLE.path,\n            rasterIconPath: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.RASTER.path,\n            manifestPath: {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01V4BSPPAYuzjuMF7Tix3ZNL","type":"tool_result","content":"export type SupportedHomepageLanguage = 'cs' | 'en';\n\nexport const fallbackHomepageLanguage: SupportedHomepageLanguage = 'en';\n\nexport function getPreferredHomepageLanguage(acceptLanguage: string | null): SupportedHomepageLanguage {\n    if (!acceptLanguage) {\n        return fallbackHomepageLanguage;\n    }\n\n    const acceptedLanguages = acceptLanguage\n        .split(',')\n        .map((entry, index) => {\n            const [languageRange, ...parameters] = entry.trim().split(';');\n            const qualityParameter = parameters.find((parameter) => parameter.trim().startsWith('q='));\n            const quality = qualityParameter ? Number(qualityParameter.trim().slice(2)) : 1;\n\n            return {\n                language: languageRange.toLowerCase(),\n                quality: Number.isFinite(quality) ? quality : 1,\n                index,\n            };\n        })\n        .filter(({ quality }) => quality > 0)\n        .sort((a, b) => b.quality - a.quality || a.index - b.index);\n\n    for (const { language } of 'cs';\n    const { header } = getHomepageContent(resolvedLanguage);\n    const [scrolled, setScrolled] = useState(false);\n\n    useEffect(() => {\n        const handleScroll = () => {\n            setScrolled(window.scrollY > 20);\n        };\n        window.addEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);\n        return () => window.removeEventListener('scroll', handleScroll);\n    }, []);\n\n    const handleCTAClick = () => {\n        // Dispatch custom event to open qualification popup\n        window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('open-qualification-popup'));\n    };\n\n    const hasNavItems = !isBare && !!navItems?.length;\n    const resolvedBrandHref = brandHref ?? (\n                <>\n                    <span className=\"sm:hidden\">{resolvedPrimaryAction.mobileLabel}</span>\n                    <span className=\"hidden sm:inline\">{resolvedPrimaryAction.label}</span>\n                </>\n            ) : (\n                <span>{resolvedPrimaryAction.label}</span>\n            )}\n            <ArrowRight className=\"ml-1.5 w-4 h-4\" />\n        </>\n    );\n\n    const primaryButton = resolvedPrimaryAction.href ? (\n                        <nav className=\"hidden lg:flex items-center gap-1 text-sm text-slate-600\">\n                            {navItems!.map((item) => (\n                                <Link\n ))}\n                        </nav>\n                    ) : (\n                        !isBare &&\n                        !hideCenterContent && (\n                            <div className=\"hidden Vraťte se na úvodní stránku.',\n            homeLabel: 'Zpět na úvod',\n            navigationLabel: 'Osobní web',\n            navigation: [\n                { label: 'Úvod', internalPath: PAVOL_CZECH_INTERNAL_PATH },\n                { label: 'Služby', internalPath: `${PAVOL_CZECH_INTERNAL_PATH}#services` },\n                { label: 'Projekty', internalPath: `${PAVOL_CZECH_INTERNAL_PATH}#projects` },\n                { label: 'English', internalPath: PAVOL_ENGLISH_INTERNAL_PATH },\n            ],\n        },\n    },\n    {\n        hostname: PUBLIC_DOMAIN_HOSTS.pavolEnglish,\n        origin: `https://${PUBLIC_DOMAIN_HOSTS.pavolEnglish}`,\n        internalPath: PAVOL_ENGLISH_INTERNAL_PATH,\n        publicPathSuffixes: PAVOL_PUBLIC_PATH_SUFFIXES,\n        notFound: {\n            language: 'en',\n            appearance: 'personal',\n            siteName: 'Pavol Hejný',\n            logoPath: '/logo/pavol-hejny-ph.svg',\n            title: 'Page not found',\n            description: \"This page is not on Pavol Hejný's personal site. Return to the homepage.\",\n            homeLabel: 'Back to home',\n            navigationLabel: 'Personal site',\n            navigation: [\n                { label: 'Home', internalPath: PAVOL_ENGLISH_INTERNAL_PATH },\n                { label: 'Services', internalPath: `${PAVOL_ENGLISH_INTERNAL_PATH}#services` },\n                { label: 'Projects', internalPath: `${PAVOL_ENGLISH_INTERNAL_PATH}#projects` },\n                { label: 'Čeština', internalPath: PAVOL_CZECH_INTERNAL_PATH },\n            ],\n        },\n    },\n];\n\n/**\n * Removes a port, a trailing DNS dot, a leading `www.`, and letter-case differences from a host before comparing it.\n *\n * A `www.` host is universally an alias of its bare apex, so folding it away here lets one apex hostname stand for both\n * forms everywhere — the primary Promptbook hosts and every independently branded domain alike. Without it, a visitor\n * who types `www.ai-ta-krajta.cz` would match no branded route and be dropped onto the Promptbook homepage.\n */\nexport function normalizeHostname(hostname: string): string {\n    const hostnameWithoutPort = hostname.trim().replace(/:\\d+$/, '');\n\n    return hostnameWithoutPort\n        .replace(/\\.$/, '')\n        .toLowerCase()\n        .replace(/^www\\./, '');\n}\n\n/** Read the visitor-facing host before a reverse proxy substitutes its internal address. */\nexport function getPublicRequestHostname(requestHeaders: Pick<Headers, 'get'>, fallbackHostname = ''): string {\n    const forwardedHostname = requestHeaders.get('x-forwarded-host')?.split(',')[0];\n\n    return normalizeHostname(forwardedHostname ?? requestHeaders.get('host') ?? fallbackHostname);\n}\n\n/**\n * Tells whether a hostname is one of the public Promptbook hosts.\n */\nexport function isPrimarySiteHostname(hostname: string): boolean {\n    const normalizedHostname = normalizeHostname(hostname);\n\n    return PRIMARY_SITE_HOSTNAMES.some((primarySiteHostname) => primarySiteHostname === normalizedHostname);\n}\n\n/**\n * Finds the independently branded site served by a hostname.\n */\nexport function getPublicDomainRouteByHostname(hostname: string): PublicDomainRoute | undefined {\n    const normalizedHostname = normalizeHostname(hostname);\n\n    return PUBLIC_DOMAIN_ROUTES.find((publicDomainRoute) => publicDomainRoute.hostname === normalizedHostname);\n}\n\n/**\n * Tells whether a pathname is one route or a child route below it, without mistaking a shared string prefix for one.\n */\nfunction isPathnameWithinPath(pathname: string, path: string): boolean {\n    return pathname === path || pathname.startsWith(`${path}/`);\n}\n\n/**\n * Finds the independently branded site whose existing internal route owns a pathname.\n */\nexport function getPublicDomainRouteByInternalPathname(pathname: string): PublicDomainRoute | undefined {\n    return PUBLIC_DOMAIN_ROUTES.find((publicDomainRoute) =>\n        isPathnameWithinPath(pathname, publicDomainRoute.internalPath),\n    );\n}\n\n/**\n * Turns an existing internal route into the matching path at its independent domain.\n */\nexport function getPublicPathname(publicDomainRoute: PublicDomainRoute, internalPathname: string): string {\n    if (internalPathname === publicDomainRoute.internalPath) {\n        return '/';\n    }\n\n    return internalPathname.slice(publicDomainRoute.internalPath.length);\n}\n\n/**\n * Finds the existing application route which should render one public custom-domain path.\n */\nexport function getInternalPathname(publicDomainRoute: PublicDomainRoute, publicPathname: string): string | undefined {\n    const normalizedPublicPathname =\n        publicPathname.length > 1 ? publicPathname.replace(/\\/+$/, '') : publicPathname;\n    const publicPathSuffix = publicDomainRoute.publicPathSuffixes.find(\n        (candidatePublicPathSuffix) => normalizedPublicPathname === `/${candidatePublicPathSuffix.path.replace(/^\\//, '')}`,\n    );\n\n    if (publicPathSuffix === undefined) {\n        return undefined;\n    }\n\n    return `${publicDomainRoute.internalPath}${publicPathSuffix.path}`;\n}\n\nconst SHARED_PUBLIC_ASSET_PATH_SET = new Set(SHARED_PUBLIC_ASSET_PATHS);\n\n/**\n * Build output and known public-file locations are shared by all three sites.\n * APIs, including the contact form endpoint and authenticated admin APIs, bypass the middleware matcher.\n */\nexport function isSharedDeploymentAssetPath(pathname: string): boolean {\n    if (pathname.startsWith('/_next/')) {\n        return true;\n    }\n\n    return SHARED_PUBLIC_ASSET_PATH_SET.has(pathname);\n}\n\n/**\n * Turns an internal application path into its canonical public URL whenever that page owns an independent domain.\n * Paths that remain part of Promptbook keep the main site's canonical origin.\n */\nexport function createPublicUrl(path: string): string {\n    const inputUrl = new URL(path, PRIMARY_SITE_URL);\n\n    if (!isPrimarySiteHostname(inputUrl.hostname)) {\n        return inputUrl.toString();\n    }\n\n    const publicDomainRoute = getPublicDomainRouteByInternalPathname(inputUrl.pathname);\n\n    if (!publicDomainRoute) {\n        return inputUrl.toString();\n    }\n\n    return new URL(\n        `${getPublicPathname(publicDomainRoute, inputUrl.pathname)}${inputUrl.search}${inputUrl.hash}`,\n        publicDomainRoute.origin,\n    ).toString();\n}\n\n/**\n * Keeps navigation within the current site on its current host, including local and preview hosts.\n * A link which crosses into another public site uses that site's canonical absolute URL.\n */\nexport function createPublicNavigationUrl(path: string, requestHostname: string): string {\n    const publicUrl = new URL(createPublicUrl(path));\n    const currentDomainRoute = getPublicDomainRouteByHostname(requestHostname);\n    const destinationDomainRoute = getPublicDomainRouteByHostname(publicUrl.hostname);\n    const isSameSite = currentDomainRoute\n        ? destinationDomainRoute?.hostname === currentDomainRoute.hostname\n        : isPrimarySiteHostname(publicUrl.hostname);\n\n    return isSameSite ? `${publicUrl.pathname}${publicUrl.search}${publicUrl.hash}` : publicUrl.toString();\n}\n","numLines":296,"startLine":1,"totalLines":296}}}

expect(\n            createGeneratedSocialPreviewImagePath('/cs/online-workshop/participant?email=private@example.test#chat'),\n        ).toBe('/cs/online-workshop/participant/opengraph-image?v=2');\n        expect(createGeneratedSocialPreviewImagePath()).toBe('/opengraph-image?v=2');\n    });\n\n    it.each(INDEXED_PAGE_METADATA_DEFINITIONS)(\n        'serves a dedicated card for $path on its canonical domain',\n        (definition) => {\n            const metadata = createPageMetadata(definition);\n            const imagePath = `${definition.path}/opengraph-image`;\n            const imageUrl = new URL(createPublicUrl(`${imagePath}?v=2`));\n            const domain = getPublicDomainRouteByHostname(imageUrl.hostname);\n\n            expect(definition.isSocialPreviewImageGenerated).toBe(true);\n            expect(existsSync(join(process.cwd(), 'app', definition.path, 'opengraph-image.tsx'))).toBe(true);\n            if (domain) {\n                expect(getInternalPathname(domain, imageUrl.pathname)).toBe(imagePath);\n            }\n\n            expect(metadata.openGraph?.images).toEqual(metadata.twitter?.images);\n            expect(metadata.openGraph?.images).toEqual([\n                {\n                    url: imageUrl.toString(),\n                    width: 1200,\n                    height: 630,\n                    type: 'image/png',\n                    alt: definition.socialPreviewImageAlt ?? definition.socialTitle ?? definition.title,\n                },\n            ]);\n        },\n    );\n\n    it('derives the visible brand, localized copy and hostname from the same page definition', () => {\n        const options = createSocialPreviewOptions({\n            path: '/en/pavol?fullname=Private&email=private@example.test',\n            language: 'en',\n            title: 'Document title',\n            socialTitle: 'Public title',\n            description: 'Document description',\n            socialDescription: 'Public description',\n            brand: { name: 'Pavol Hejný' },\n        });\n\n        expect(options).toMatchObject({\n            brandLabel: 'Pavol Hejný',\n            hostname: 'pavolhejny.com',\n            title: 'Public title',\n            description: 'Public description',\n        });\n        expect(JSON.stringify(options)).not.toMatch(/Private|private@example/);\n    });\n});\n","numLines":69,"startLine":1,"totalLines":69}}}

{ DISCOUNT_CODE_QUERY_PARAMETER, REGISTRATION_SECTION_ID } from '@/lib/discounts/discountCodeConstants';\nimport { AI_SUPERVIZE_MINI_PATH, createDiscountCodePrefillPath } from '@/lib/discounts/discountPlaces';\nimport {\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS,\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_BRAND_NAME,\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_BRANDING_PATH,\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_EPISODE_SEARCH_API_PATH,\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_MANIFEST_PATH,\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_MEDIA_KIT_PATH,\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_PATH,\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_RSS_FEED_MEDIA_TYPE,\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_RSS_FEED_PLATFORM,\n} from '@/businesses/ai-ta-krajta/config';\nimport { expect, test, type APIRequestContext, type Page } from '@playwright/test';\n\n/**\n * Every public address which renders a page of its own.\n */\nconst PUBLIC_PAGE_PATHS = [\n    '/cs',\n    '/en',\n    '/pro-mesta',\n    '/for-agro',\n    '/for-industry',\n    '/ai-supervize',\n    AI_SUPERVIZE_MINI_PATH,\n    // '/ai-supervize-mini',\n    '/ai-ta-krajta',\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_MEDIA_KIT_PATH,\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_BRANDING_PATH,\n    '/hackathon-factory',\n    '/cs/online-workshop',\n    '/cs/komunita/clenstvi',\n    '/cs/pavol',\n    '/en/pavol',\n    '/cs/ochrana-osobnich-udaju',\n    '/en/privacy-policy',\n    '/cs/obchodni-podminky',\n    '/en/terms-and-conditions',\n    '/contact',\n    '/branding',\n    '/data-deletion',\n    '/old',\n] as const;\n\ntype PublicPagePath = (typeof PUBLIC_PAGE_PATHS)[number];\n\n/**\n * The address which used to hold the training and now only forwards to the workshop it became\n */\nconst RETIRED_TRAINING_PATH = '/skoleni';\n\n/**\n * A public address which renders nothing itself and only forwards to a page of this suite.\n *\n * Note: A route reading `Accept-Language` may pick any of its localized destinations, so every one of them is\n *       accepted and every one of them is rendered by its own page check above.\n */\ntype PublicRedirect = {\n    readonly path: string;\n    readonly statusCode: number;\n    readonly destinationPaths: readonly PublicPagePath[];\n};\n\nconst PERMANENT_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE = 308;\nconst TEMPORARY_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE = 307;\n\nconst PUBLIC_REDIRECTS: readonly PublicRedirect[] = [\n    { path: '/', statusCode: TEMPORARY_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE, destinationPaths: ['/cs', '/en'] },\n    { path: '/pavol', statusCode: TEMPORARY_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE, destinationPaths: ['/cs/pavol', '/en/pavol'] },\n    {\n        path: '/privacy',\n        statusCode: TEMPORARY_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE,\n        destinationPaths: ['/cs/ochrana-osobnich-udaju', '/en/privacy-policy'],\n    },\n    {\n        path: '/terms',\n        statusCode: TEMPORARY_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE,\n        destinationPaths: ['/cs/obchodni-podminky', '/en/terms-and-conditions'],\n    },\n    {\n        path: RETIRED_TRAINING_PATH,\n        statusCode: PERMANENT_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE,\n        destinationPaths: [AI_SUPERVIZE_MINI_PATH],\n    },\n];\n\nconst E2E_DISCOUNT_CODE = 'E2E SLEVA';\n\nconst PUBLIC_PAGE_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 180_000;\n\nasync function expectPublicPageToLoad(page: Page, path: PublicPagePath): Promise<void> {\n    const response = await page.goto(path, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });\n\n    expect(response, `Expected ${path} to produce a document response`).not.toBeNull();\n    expect(response!.ok(), `Expected ${path} to load without a server error`).toBeTruthy();\n    await expect(\n        page.locator('main, h1, footer').first(),\n        `Expected ${path} to render visible page content`,\n    ).toBeVisible();\n}\n\n/**\n * Reads where a redirect points, whether it answers with an absolute or a site-relative `Location`.\n */\nfunction readRedirectDestinationPath(locationHeader: string, requestUrl: string): string {\n    const destinationUrl = new URL(locationHeader, requestUrl);\n\n    return `${destinationUrl.pathname}${destinationUrl.search}${destinationUrl.hash}`;\n}\n\n/**\n * Asks a redirecting address where it points without following it, so the destination is rendered once by the page\n * check which owns it instead of a second time through every address leading to it.\n */\nasync function readRedirectDestination(\n    request: APIRequestContext,\n    path: string,\n    expectedStatusCode: number,\n): Promise<string> {\n    const response = await request.get(path, { maxRedirects: 0 });\n\n    expect(response.status(), `Expected ${path} to answer with status ${expectedStatusCode}`).toBe(expectedStatusCode);\n\n    const locationHeader = response.headers()['location'];\n    expect(locationHeader, `Expected ${path} to name where it redirects`).toBeDefined();\n\n    return readRedirectDestinationPath(locationHeader, response.url());\n}\n\nfor (const path of PUBLIC_PAGE_PATHS) {\n    // Next.js compiles a route on its first dev-server visit. Isolating every route keeps earlier cold compilations\n    // from exhausting the timeout of a healthy page later in the smoke suite.\n    test(`public landing and information page loads: ${path}`, async ({ page }) => {\n        await expectPublicPageToLoad(page, path);\n    });\n}\n\ntest('AI ta Krajta collaboration section deep-links to its media kit', async ({ page }) => {\n    await page.goto(AI_TA_KRAJTA_PATH, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });\n\n    const mediaKitLink = page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Otevřít media kit' });\n    await expect(mediaKitLink).toHaveAttribute('href', AI_TA_KRAJTA_MEDIA_KIT_PATH);\n    await mediaKitLink.click();\n\n    await expect(page).toHaveURL(AI_TA_KRAJTA_MEDIA_KIT_PATH);\n    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: /Oslovte české a slovenské publikum/i })).toBeVisible();\n});\n\ntest('AI ta Krajta owns its metadata, icon and installable manifest and credits Promptbook coder', async ({ page }) => {\n    await page.goto(AI_TA_KRAJTA_PATH, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });\n    await expect(page.locator('footer')).toBeVisible();\n    await expect(page).toHaveTitle(`${AI_TA_KRAJTA_BRAND_NAME} | Český podcast o umělé inteligenci`);\n\n    const metadataIdentity = await page.evaluate(\n        ({ scalableIconPath, rasterIconPath, manifestPath, rssFeedMediaType, rssFeedUrl, rssFeedLabel }) => {\n            const identityTags = Array.from(document.head.querySelectorAll('meta, link'));\n            const structuredDataNodes = Array.from(document.head.querySelectorAll('script[type*=ld]'));\n            const footerText = document.querySelector('footer')?.textContent ?? '';\n\n            const isPromptbookIdentityAbsent = identityTags\n                .filter((element) => /application-name|creator|publisher|og:site_name|twitter:site/.test(element.outerHTML))\n                .every((element) => !element.outerHTML.includes('Promptbook'));\n            const isPromptbookStructuredDataAbsent = structuredDataNodes.every(\n                (element) => !(element.textContent ?? '').includes('Promptbook'),\n            );\n            const isPodcastIconUsed = identityTags.some(\n                (element) =>\n                    element.getAttribute('rel') === 'icon' && element.getAttribute('href') === scalableIconPath,\n            );\n            const isPodcastTouchIconUsed = identityTags.some(\n                (element) =>\n                    element.getAttribute('rel') === 'apple-touch-icon' &&\n                    element.getAttribute('href') === rasterIconPath,\n            );\n            const isPodcastManifestUsed = identityTags.some(\n                (element) => element.getAttribute('rel') === 'manifest' && element.getAttribute('href') === manifestPath,\n            );\n            const isPodcastRssFeedAdvertised = identityTags.some(\n                (element) =>\n                    element.getAttribute('rel') === 'alternate' &&\n                    element.getAttribute('type') === rssFeedMediaType &&\n                    element.getAttribute('href') === rssFeedUrl,\n            );\n            const isPodcastRssFeedLinked = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a')).some(\n                (element) => element.textContent?.trim() === rssFeedLabel && element.getAttribute('href') === rssFeedUrl,\n            );\n            const isLegalCompanyPresent = footerText.includes('AI Web s.r.o.');\n\n            return {\n                isPromptbookIdentityAbsent,\n                isPromptbookStructuredDataAbsent,\n                isPodcastIconUsed,\n                isPodcastTouchIconUsed,\n                isPodcastManifestUsed,\n                isPodcastRssFeedAdvertised,\n                isPodcastRssFeedLinked,\n                isLegalCompanyPresent,\n            };\n        },\n        {\n            scalableIconPath: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.SCALABLE.path,\n            rasterIconPath: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.RASTER.path,\n            manifestPath: AI_TA_KRAJTA_MANIFEST_PATH,\n            rssFeedMediaType: AI_TA_KRAJTA_RSS_FEED_MEDIA_TYPE,\n            rssFeedUrl: AI_TA_KRAJTA_RSS_FEED_PLATFORM.url,\n            rssFeedLabel: AI_TA_KRAJTA_RSS_FEED_PLATFORM.label,\n        },\n    );\n\n    expect(metadataIdentity).toEqual({\n        isPromptbookIdentityAbsent: true,\n        isPromptbookStructuredDataAbsent: true,\n        isPodcastIconUsed: true,\n        isPodcastTouchIconUsed: true,\n        isPodcastManifestUsed: true,\n        isPodcastRssFeedAdvertised: true,\n        isPodcastRssFeedLinked: true,\n        isLegalCompanyPresent: true,\n    });\n\n    await expect(page.locator('footer').getByRole('link', { name: 'Done by Promptbook coder', exact: true }))\n        .toHaveAttribute('href', 'https://coder.ptbk.io/');\n\n    const manifestResponse = await page.request.get(AI_TA_KRAJTA_MANIFEST_PATH);\n\n    expect(manifestResponse.ok()).toBeTruthy();\n    expect(await manifestResponse.json()).toMatchObject({\n        name: AI_TA_KRAJTA_BRAND_NAME,\n        short_name: AI_TA_KRAJTA_BRAND_NAME,\n        icons: [\n            { src: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.SCALABLE.path, purpose: 'any' },\n            { src: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.RASTER.path, purpose: 'any' },\n            { src: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.RASTER.path, purpose: 'maskable' },\n        ],\n    });\n\n    for (const appIcon of [AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.SCALABLE, AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.RASTER]) {\n        const iconResponse = await page.request.get(appIcon.path);\n\n        expect(iconResponse.ok(), `Expected ${appIcon.path} to be served`).toBeTruthy();\n        expect(iconResponse.headers()['content-type']).toContain(appIcon.type);\n    }\n});\n\ntest('AI ta Krajta searches complete transcripts on the server without sending them to the browser', async ({ page, request }) => {\n    const transcriptSearchResponse = await request.get(\n        `${AI_TA_KRAJTA_EPISODE_SEARCH_API_PATH}?${new URLSearchParams({ search: 'zahradníkem' }).toString()}`,\n    );\n    const transcriptSearchResponseText = await transcriptSearchResponse.text();\n\n    expect(transcriptSearchResponse.ok()).toBeTruthy();\n    expect(JSON.parse(transcriptSearchResponseText)).toMatchObject({ episodeSlugs: expect.arrayContaining(['65']) });\n    expect(transcriptSearchResponseText).not.toContain('Kozel za hradníkem');\n\n    await page.goto(AI_TA_KRAJTA_PATH, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });\n    await page.getByRole('searchbox', { name: 'Hledat v dílech' }).fill('zahradníkem');\n\n    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: /AI zrychlí vývoj 10x/ })).toBeVisible();\n    await expect(page.locator('body')).not.toContainText('Kozel za hradníkem');\n});\n\nfor (const publicRedirect of PUBLIC_REDIRECTS) {\n    test(`public address redirects to its page: ${publicRedirect.path}`, async ({ request }) => {\n        test.setTimeout(PUBLIC_PAGE_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS);\n\n        const destinationPath = await readRedirectDestination(request, publicRedirect.path, publicRedirect.statusCode);\n\n        expect(\n            publicRedirect.destinationPaths.some((candidatePath) => candidatePath === destinationPath),\n            `Expected ${publicRedirect.path} to redirect to ${publicRedirect.destinationPaths.join(\n                ' or ',\n            )}, but it pointed at ${destinationPath}`,\n        ).toBeTruthy();\n    });\n}\n\ntest(`${RETIRED_TRAINING_PATH} carries a discount code to the workshop registration`, async ({ request }) => {\n    test.setTimeout(PUBLIC_PAGE_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS);\n\n    const destinationPath = await readRedirectDestination(\n        request,\n        `${RETIRED_TRAINING_PATH}?${DISCOUNT_CODE_QUERY_PARAMETER}=${encodeURIComponent(E2E_DISCOUNT_CODE)}`,\n        PERMANENT_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE,\n    );\n\n    expect(destinationPath, `Expected ${RETIRED_TRAINING_PATH} to pre-fill the discount code it was given`).toBe(\n        createDiscountCodePrefillPath(AI_SUPERVIZE_MINI_PATH, REGISTRATION_SECTION_ID, E2E_DISCOUNT_CODE),\n    );\n});\n","numLines":291,"startLine":1,"totalLines":291}}}

{"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01HUNcZ6T8s4CKPLS4aLL83a","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t[ ]\n2\t\n3\t[✨⚙️] Reposition the main Promptbook homepage around autonomous agendas\n4\t\n5\t- Replace the **main Promptbook homepage proposition** with the product model described below. This is a conceptual repositioning, not a cosmetic copy refresh.\n6\t- Prerequisite/context: the previous PRD preserves today's Czech company-data landing page at `/cs/pro-firmy`. Do not delete that proposition while redesigning the main homepage.\n7\t- The central mental model must change from **\"AI agent / virtual employee that answers questions over documents\"** to **\"Promptbook turns powerful AI agents into long-running agendas/responsibilities that operate in the background.\"**\n8\t- Core idea to communicate:\n9\t    - Modern coding agents/harnesses can already perform remarkably complex one-shot tasks.\n10\t    - A company or project does not primarily need more impressive one-shot prompts. It needs important responsibilities to be handled reliably over time.\n11\t    - Promptbook packages those responsibilities as an **agenda**: a bounded area of responsibility with its own context, goals, recurring and one-off tasks, agents, rules and tools.\n12\t    - Multiple agents can work inside one agenda. The agenda is the durable unit; an individual agent or prompt is an implementation detail.\n13\t    - The agenda should be able to keep running in the background instead of requiring a human to repeatedly open a chat, restate context and ask for the next action.\n14\t    - Human interaction still matters: people can inspect, correct, approve, steer and change the agenda. The promise is not \"humans disappear\"; it is that routine continuation does not require continuous prompting.\n15\t- A useful framing is: **companies are made of agendas / responsibilities, not prompts**. A healthy company resembles a well-running machine because its recurring responsibilities keep being handled. Promptbook should make more of those responsibilities executable by AI.\n16\t- Avoid presenting \"agenda\" as merely a synonym for a scheduled task. An agenda can contain many goals and many tasks with different lifecycles. For example, accounting is an agenda; VAT filing, deadline monitoring and document processing are tasks/goals within it.\n17\t- Examples are important for comprehension, but the homepage must not make Promptbook look like a single-purpose accounting, inbox or website product. Use examples to reveal the general principle, then return to the abstraction.\n18\t- Strong example to feature: **a website/application that maintains itself**.\n19\t    - One-shot website/app generators can create an impressive initial result, but a real website or application needs ongoing maintenance and evolution.\n20\t    - Promptbook can use strong coding harnesses to turn \"maintain and evolve this application\" into an ongoing agenda: understand the repository, work through changes, maintain quality, test, fix, update and continue over time.\n21\t    - The user should perceive the maintained product/responsibility, not be forced to operate the underlying coding harness manually.\n22\t- Other illustrative agendas can include customer communication / keeping an inbox handled, accounting/administrative responsibilities, content or website operations, and company-specific operational responsibilities. Keep examples credible and avoid claiming unsupported fully autonomous/legal/accounting capabilities as already guaranteed.\n23\t- Product differentiation to communicate without turning the hero into a technical feature list:\n24\t    - **Professional/project context:** designed for real company/project responsibilities, not only personal background automations.\n25\t    - **Vendor independence:** the durable agenda is not conceptually tied to one model vendor. Promptbook can orchestrate different capable models/coding harnesses (for example OpenAI Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode) as implementation choices. Verify the exact supported integrations in the repository/product before making named compatibility claims.\n26\t    - **Coding harnesses as leverage:** Promptbook deliberately builds on very strong coding agents/harnesses. Code can exist under the hood when it is the best way to execute an agenda, without exposing that complexity as the user's primary interface.\n27\t    - **Git/repository as durable workspace:** where appropriate, explain that an agenda can live in a folder/Git repository containing durable context, agent definitions, instructions/PRDs/tasks and history. Do not require a nontechnical visitor to understand Git before they understand the product.\n28\t- Messaging hierarchy:\n29\t    1. First make the visitor understand the outcome: **a responsibility can keep being handled in the background**.\n30\t    2. Then introduce the word **agenda** and explain it as a durable area of responsibility.\n31\t    3. Show how an agenda contains context + goals/tasks + agents/tools and persists over time.\n32\t    4. Show concrete examples, with self-maintaining software/web as the strongest/most native example.\n33\t    5. Only after the concept is clear explain the technical leverage: strong coding harnesses, repositories, multiple models/vendors.\n34\t- The page must clearly contrast:\n35\t    - **one-shot AI:** \"do this task now\" / impressive but ends after the task,\n36\t    - **agenda:** \"take responsibility for this area over time\" / continues, observes, acts and escalates when needed.\n37\t- Do not frame ChatGPT, Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode or other strong agents as bad or obsolete. The positioning is explicitly that these systems are excellent and Promptbook **builds on their strength** to make them persistent and operational.\n38\t- Avoid generic AI-marketing language such as \"revolutionize your business\", \"AI employee for everything\", or unsupported claims of total autonomy.\n39\t- Avoid over-indexing on the term \"agent\". A visitor should leave remembering **their agenda/responsibility**, not Promptbook's internal agent taxonomy.\n40\t- Avoid automatically adding supporting copy, subheadlines or explanatory filler under every heading. If text does not add new information, omit it. The heading and UI/visual itself should carry the idea whenever possible.\n41\t- Design direction:\n42\t    - Reuse the existing Promptbook visual language where it helps, but redesign sections whose current structure is coupled to the old company-document proposition.\n43\t    - Prefer a visual explanation of the model over walls of prose.\n44\t    - Consider a simple diagram/interactive composition such as `Agenda → context + tasks/goals + agents/tools → continuous background work → outcomes/escalations`, but implement the clearest solution consistent with the current design system.\n45\t    - Make \"one-shot → ongoing agenda\" visually obvious above the fold or immediately after the hero.\n46\t    - The page must remain polished and understandable on mobile, not only desktop.\n47\t- Information architecture:\n48\t    - `/cs` becomes the new Czech agenda-based main homepage.\n49\t    - `/en` should express the same product positioning in natural English, not a literal awkward translation. Use \"agenda\", \"area of responsibility\", \"ongoing responsibility\" or another clear formulation as needed, while preserving the product concept.\n50\t    - Root language redirect behavior in `app/page.tsx` must continue to work.\n51\t    - Update homepage metadata, descriptions, keywords, Open Graph/social preview copy/artwork and structured SEO data so they no longer describe the main product only as company-document Q&A.\n52\t    - Keep the preserved Czech company-focused/data-focused proposition accessible at `/cs/pro-firmy`.\n53\t- Conversion:\n54\t    - Keep a clear primary CTA, but make its surrounding copy fit the new proposition.\n55\t    - Inspect the current strategic-call/qualification flow and reuse it if it still makes sense. {"type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_019q7TiEsiq6Zxh1HK5bVetM","type":"tool_result","content":"1\timport { ONLINE_WORKSHOP_PARTICIPANT_PATH } from '@/businesses/online-workshop/config';\n2\t\n3\tconst ADMIN_TRACKING_EXCLUDED_PATH_PREFIXES = ['/admin'] as const;\n4\tconst SENSITIVE_TRACKING_QUERY_PARAMETERS = ['email', 'fullname', 'token'] as const;\n5\t\n6\tfunction isWorkshopParticipantPath(pathname: string): boolean {\n7\t    return pathname === ONLINE_WORKSHOP_PARTICIPANT_PATH || pathname.startsWith(`${ONLINE_WORKSHOP_PARTICIPANT_PATH}/`);\n8\t}\n9\t\n10\tfunction isPathExcluded(pathname: string, excludedPathPrefixes: readonly string[]): boolean {\n11\t    return excludedPathPrefixes.some(\n12\t        (excludedPrefix) => pathname === excludedPrefix || pathname.startsWith(`${excludedPrefix}/`),\n13\t    );\n14\t}\n15\t\n16\t/**\n17\t * Admin URLs carry a bearer token and the participant URL can carry personal\n18\t * data. Neither page may receive normal page tracking or session recording.\n19\t */\n20\texport function isThirdPartyTrackingAllowed(pathname: string): boolean {\n21\t    return !isPathExcluded(pathname, ADMIN_TRACKING_EXCLUDED_PATH_PREFIXES) && !isWorkshopParticipantPath(pathname);\n22\t}\n23\t\n24\t/**\n25\t * The participant room sends only explicit anonymized interaction events to\n26\t * Google Analytics. It never sends its URL as a page view because that URL can\n27\t * temporarily contain a prefilled e-mail address or full name.\n28\t */\n29\texport function isGoogleAnalyticsAllowed(pathname: string): boolean {\n30\t    return !isPathExcluded(pathname, ADMIN_TRACKING_EXCLUDED_PATH_PREFIXES);\n31\t}\n32\t\n33\texport function isGoogleAnalyticsPageViewAllowed(pathname: string): boolean {\n34\t    return isGoogleAnalyticsAllowed(pathname) && !isWorkshopParticipantPath(pathname);\n35\t}\n36\t\n37\t/**\n38\t * Defense in depth for any URL recorded before a page-level exclusion takes\n39\t * effect, including same-origin API calls.\n40\t */\n41\texport function removeSensitiveTrackingParameters(url: string): string {\n42\t    try {\n43\t        const parsedUrl = new URL(\n44\t            url,\n45\t            typeof window === 'undefined' ? 'https://www.promptbook.studio' : window.location.origin,\n46\t        );\n47\t        SENSITIVE_TRACKING_QUERY_PARAMETERS.forEach((parameterName) => parsedUrl.searchParams.delete(parameterName));\n48\t        return parsedUrl.toString();\n49\t    } catch {\n50\t        return url;\n51\t    }\n52\t}\n53\t"}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"e45c8504-6a06-43dd-b769-a6ab7d0996f1","uuid":"fda4ffab-75ba-4884-9a5d-9879d2c6096c","timestamp":"2026-09-30T22:03:23.493Z","tool_use_result":{"type":"text","file":{"filePath":"C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\lib\\tracking\\trackingExclusions.ts","content":"import { ONLINE_WORKSHOP_PARTICIPANT_PATH } from '@/businesses/online-workshop/config';\n\nconst ADMIN_TRACKING_EXCLUDED_PATH_PREFIXES = ['/admin'] as const;\nconst SENSITIVE_TRACKING_QUERY_PARAMETERS = ['email', 'fullname', 'token'] as const;\n\nfunction isWorkshopParticipantPath(pathname: string): boolean {\n    return pathname === ONLINE_WORKSHOP_PARTICIPANT_PATH || pathname.startsWith(`${ONLINE_WORKSHOP_PARTICIPANT_PATH}/`);\n}\n\nfunction isPathExcluded(pathname: string, excludedPathPrefixes: readonly string[]): boolean {\n    return excludedPathPrefixes.some(\n        (excludedPrefix) => pathname === excludedPrefix || pathname.startsWith(`${excludedPrefix}/`),\n    );\n}\n\n/**\n * Admin URLs carry a bearer token and the participant URL can carry personal\n * data. Neither page may receive normal page tracking or session recording.\n */\nexport function isThirdPartyTrackingAllowed(pathname: string): boolean {\n    return !isPathExcluded(pathname, ADMIN_TRACKING_EXCLUDED_PATH_PREFIXES) && !isWorkshopParticipantPath(pathname);\n}\n\n/**\n * The participant room sends only explicit anonymized interaction events to\n * Google Analytics. It never sends its URL as a page view because that URL can\n * temporarily contain a prefilled e-mail address or full name.\n */\nexport function isGoogleAnalyticsAllowed(pathname: string): boolean {\n    return !isPathExcluded(pathname, ADMIN_TRACKING_EXCLUDED_PATH_PREFIXES);\n}\n\nexport function isGoogleAnalyticsPageViewAllowed(pathname: string): boolean {\n    return isGoogleAnalyticsAllowed(pathname) && !isWorkshopParticipantPath(pathname);\n}\n\n/**\n * Defense in depth for any URL recorded before a page-level exclusion takes\n * effect, including same-origin API calls.\n */\nexport function removeSensitiveTrackingParameters(url: string): string {\n    try {\n        const parsedUrl = new URL(\n            url,\n            typeof window === 'undefined' ? 'https://www.promptbook.studio' : window.location.origin,\n        );\n        SENSITIVE_TRACKING_QUERY_PARAMETERS.forEach((parameterName) => parsedUrl.searchParams.delete(parameterName));\n        return parsedUrl.toString();\n    } catch {\n        return url;\n    }\n}\n","numLines":53,"startLine":1,"totalLines":53}}}

Dialog closes flush that editor's autosaves,\n  nested editors and active explicit operations. waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded',\n        });\n\n        const expectedImageUrl = `https://${preview.hostname}${preview.path.replace(/\\/$/, '')}/opengraph-image?v=2`;\n        await .locator('meta[property^=\"og:\"], meta[name^=\"twitter:\"]')\n            .evaluateAll((elements) => elements.map((element) => element.getAttribute('content')).join(' '));\n expect(imageResponse.status()).toBe(200);\n        expect(imageResponse.headers()['content-type']).toContain('image/png');\n        const imageBuffer = await imageResponse.body();\n Ověříme, jestli pro vás Promptbook dává smysl.',\n            submitting: 'Odesílám...',\n            submit: 'Rezervovat hovor zdarma',\n            back: 'Zpět',\n        },\n        bookingNotification: {\n            notifications: [\n                { company: 'Firma z Prahy', time: 'před 2 hodinami' },\n                { company: 'Firma z Brna', time: 'před 4 hodinami' },\n                { company: 'Firma z Ostravy', time: 'včera' },\n            ],\n            messageSuffix: 'si zarezervovala strategický hovor',\n        },\n    },\n    en: {\n        loading: 'Loading...',\n        header: {\n            fomoBefore: 'Only',\n            fomoStrong: '7 of 10 spots',\n            fomoAfter: 'left for a free strategy call',\n            ctaMobile: 'Free call',\n            ctaDesktop: 'Book a free call',\n        },\n        hero: {\n            eyebrow: 'Czech AI platform for company data',\n            heading: (\n                <>\n                    What if every\n                    <br />\n                    employee had{' '}\n                    <span className=\"bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0891b2] to-[#06b6d4] bg-clip-text text-transparent\">\n                        instant\n                        <br />\n                        access\n                    </span>{' '}\n                    to everything your\n                    <br />\n                    company has ever written?\n                </>\n            ),\n            description: (\n                <>\n                    Promptbook reads up to one million standard pages of your documents and answers anything. A new hire\n                    can ask, and so can a seasoned manager. Both get the same precise answer.\n                </>\n            ),\n            cta: 'I want a free strategy call',\n            badges: ['100% GDPR', 'Up to 1,000,000 standard pages', 'Czech platform'],\n            chatTitle: 'Promptbook - HR Assistant',\n            chatInputPlaceholder: 'Type a question...',\n            chatMessages: [\n                {\n                    id: 1,\n                    type: 'user',\n                    text: \"Hi, I just started here and I can't find how many vacation days I get. Can you help?\",\n                    startDelay: 0,\n                    static: true,\n                },\n                {\n                    id: 2,\n                    type: 'bot',\n                    text: 'Welcome to the company, Anna! According to the employee handbook, you get **25 vacation days per year**.',\n                    startDelay: 2000,\n                    static: false,\n                },\n                {\n                    id: 3,\n                    type: 'bot',\n                    text: \"I'll email it to you as well, so you have it handy. Anything else?\",\n                    startDelay: 1200,\n                    static: false,\n                },\n                {\n                    id: 4,\n                    type: 'user',\n                    text: 'Great, thanks! Exactly what I needed. 🙌',\n                    startDelay: 1000,\n                    static: false,\n                },\n            ],\n        },\n        socialProof: {\n            eyebrow: 'For companies that take their data seriously',\n            industries: [\n                'Manufacturing',\n                'Law firms',\n                'Construction',\n                'Public administration',\n                'Healthcare',\n                'Education',\n                'Logistics',\n                'Energy',\n                'IT',\n                'Insurance',\n                'Pharma',\n                'E-commerce',\n                'Accounting firms',\n                'Telecom',\n            ],\n        },\n        painPoints: {\n            eyebrow: 'Why companies lose millions',\n            heading: (\n                <>\n                    The knowledge is already in your company.{' '}\n                    <span className=\"bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0891b2] to-[#06b6d4] bg-clip-text text-transparent\">\n                        Nobody can find it.\n                    </span>\n                </>\n            ),\n            points: [\n                {\n                    title: 'Scattered company data',\n                    description:\n                        \"Policies on SharePoint, contracts in email, manuals on Google Drive, processes in people's heads. It all exists. It's just spread across dozens of systems.\",\n                    consequence: 'Employees search instead of doing the work you pay them for.',\n                },\n                {\n                    title: 'Key people as an internal help desk',\n                    description:\n                        'Senior people answer the same questions over and over, from newcomers and colleagues alike. Instead of strategic work, they run an information desk.',\n                    consequence: 'Your most expensive people are doing work a system should be doing.',\n                },\n                {\n                    title: 'Public AI risk',\n                    description:\n                        \"People paste work into public ChatGPT, sensitive company documents included. Public AI doesn't know your company. When it doesn't have the answer, it makes one up.\",\n                    consequence:\n                        'One decision based on invented information can cost more than your whole annual software budget.',\n                },\n                {\n                    title: 'Departing know-how',\n                    description:\n                        'When an experienced person leaves, they take knowledge nobody wrote down. How decisions get made, what each client has been through, why things are done this way.',\n                    consequence: \"The company loses years of experience, and you don't get that back quickly.\",\n                },\n            ],\n            timeAllocation: {\n                title: \"Where does your team's time go?\",\n                beforeLabel: 'Before',\n                beforePrimary: 'Busywork',\n                beforeSecondary: '20%',\n                beforeNote: 'Emails · Meetings · Routine tasks',\n                afterLabel: 'After deploying Promptbook',\n                afterPrimary: 'What matters',\n                afterSecondary: '20%',\n                afterNote: 'Family · Creativity · Strategic work',\n            },\n        },\n        solution: {\n            eyebrow: 'Solution',\n            heading: (\n                <>\n                    A virtual employee who{' '}\n                    <span className=\"bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0891b2] to-[#06b6d4] bg-clip-text text-transparent\">\n                        knows the whole company.\n                    </span>\n                </>\n            ),\n            description:\n                'Upload your company documents into a secure vault. Promptbook turns them into a virtual employee: an HR specialist, a lawyer, a technician. Then anyone can just ask, in plain language.',\n            benefits: [\n                {\n                    title: 'No prompting',\n                    description:\n                        'No training. No \"write the prompt like an IT person would\". Your people are experts in their field, not in casting spells on robots. They ask, by text or by voice, and they get an answer.',\n                    highlight: 'The same way they talk to a colleague.',\n                },\n                {\n                    title: 'Context vault',\n                    description:\n                        \"Data never leaves your infrastructure. We don't use it to train any models. Do you know what happens when an employee pastes an NDA into public ChatGPT?\",\n                    highlight: \"We do. That's why we built it differently.\",\n                },\n                {\n                    title: '\"I don\\'t know\" beats a hallucination',\n                    description:\n                        \"Public AI invents five paragraphs that sound convincing. They can cost you the company. Promptbook draws only from your data. And when it can't find the answer?\",\n                    highlight: 'It says it straight: \"I don\\'t have that information in your documents.\"',\n                },\n            ],\n        },\n        howItWorks: {\n            eyebrow: 'How it works',\n            heading: (\n                <>\n                    Deployment{' '}\n                    <span className=\"bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0891b2] to-[#06b6d4] bg-clip-text text-transparent\">\n                        without the pain.\n                    </span>\n                </>\n            ),\n            steps: [\n                {\n                    title: 'Upload documents',\n                    description:\n                        'Policies, contracts, manuals, NDAs, meeting notes. Anything sitting today in SharePoint, on Google Drive, or in a desk drawer. Promptbook handles up to one million standard pages.',\n                },\n                {\n                    title: 'Create a virtual employee',\n                    description:\n                        'An HR specialist who knows the employee handbook. A lawyer who knows every contract. A technician who knows the manuals. Each agent answers strictly from your company data.',\n                },\n                {\n                    title: 'People ask questions',\n                    description:\n                        'In plain language. Like sending a WhatsApp message. Or a voice note. No prompts, no training, no IT department.',\n                },\n            ],\n            cta: 'I want to see how it works',\n        },\n        enemy: {\n            eyebrow: 'Why not public ChatGPT',\n            heading: (\n                <>\n                    &quot;I&apos;ll just paste it into ChatGPT&quot;{' '}\n                    <span className=\"bg-gradient-to-r from-red-500 to-rose-500 bg-clip-text text-transparent\">\n                        is corporate self-sabotage.\n                    </span>\n                </>\n            ),\n            chatgptLabel: 'Public ChatGPT',\n            promptbookLabel: 'Promptbook',\n            comparisons: [\n                {\n                    feature: \"When it doesn't know\",\n                    chatgpt: 'Confidently invents one',\n                    promptbook: 'Says: \"I don\\'t know\"',\n                },\n                {\n                    feature: 'Your company data',\n                    chatgpt: 'Public cloud. Who knows who reads it',\n                    promptbook: 'Locked in your vault',\n                },\n                {\n                    feature: 'Training on your data',\n                    chatgpt: 'Yes, it trains other models on it',\n                    promptbook: 'No. Never.',\n                },\n                {\n                    feature: 'How you ask',\n                    chatgpt: '\"Act as senior lawyer, temperature 0.2...\"',\n                    promptbook: '\"Hey, where\\'s that NDA from 2021?\"',\n                },\n                {\n                    feature: 'Company context',\n                    chatgpt: 'None. It knows nothing about your company',\n                    promptbook: 'It knows your policies, contracts, processes',\n                },\n            ],\n        },\n        testimonials: {\n            eyebrow: 'Testimonials',\n            heading: (\n                <>\n                    What companies say once they{' '}\n                    <span className=\"bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0891b2] to-[#06b6d4] bg-clip-text text-transparent\">\n                        stop searching.\n                    </span>\n                </>\n            ),\n            items: [\n                {\n                    quote: \"Promptbook didn't cut us off from each other. The opposite. We finally have time for the real work we're paid to do.\",\n                    author: 'IT department',\n                    company: 'Silesian University in Opava',\n                },\n                {\n                    quote: \"Newcomers aren't afraid to ask anymore. They get answers right away, straight from our internal policies.\",\n                    author: 'Municipal district',\n                    company: 'Prague 13',\n                },\n            ],\n            metrics: [\n                { value: '1,000,000', label: 'standard pages of capacity', suffix: '' },\n                { value: '100%', label: 'GDPR compliant', suffix: '' },\n                { value: '0', label: 'hallucinations', suffix: '' },\n            ],\n        },\n        team: {\n            title: \"Who's behind this\",\n            description: (\n                <>\n                    We help companies use AI practically and safely. Our backgrounds are in research, development, and\n                    business.\n                </>\n            ),\n            jiriDescription: (\n                <>\n                    Ph.D. in Mathematics, former researcher at{' '}\n                    <Link href=\"https://www.it4i.cz/\">IT4I National Supercomputing Centre</Link>.\n                </>\n            ),\n            pavolDescription: (\n                <>\n                    One of the top <Link href=\"https://www.pavolhejny.com/\">open-source contributors</Link> in Czechia.\n                    Developer with 15+ years of experience.\n                </>\n            ),\n        },\n        finalCta: {\n            heading: (\n                <>\n                    Stop paying people to search.\n                    <br />\n                    Start paying them to work.\n                </>\n            ),\n            description:\n                \"Book a 20-minute strategy call with our team. No hard sell. We'll go through your situation and show you Promptbook running on your own data.\",\n            cta: 'Book a free strategy call',\n            capacityPrefix: 'Booked',\n            capacityStrong: '7',\n            capacitySuffix: 'of 10 spots',\n            capacityRemaining: '3 left',\n            capacityNote: 'We take on 10 companies a month at most, so we have time for each one.',\n            riskReversal:\n                \"Even if you never buy Promptbook, you'll walk away with a concrete plan for sorting out the chaos in your company data.\",\n        },\n        qualificationPopup: {\n            dialogTitle: 'Qualification form',\n            questions: [\n                {\n                    id: 'industry',\n                    question: 'What industry are you in?',\n                    type: 'single',\n                    options: [\n                        'Manufacturing / Industry',\n                        'Legal / Finance',\n                        'Construction / Real estate',\n                        'Public administration / Education',\n                        'IT / Technology',\n                        'Other industry',\n                    ],\n                },\n                {\n                    id: 'pain_point',\n                    question: \"What's your biggest headache?\",\n                    type: 'single',\n                    options: [\n                        'People spend hours searching for documents',\n                        'Senior people answer the same questions again and again',\n                        'Company data in public ChatGPT worries us',\n                        'When a key person leaves, know-how leaves with them',\n                        \"I'm just exploring what Promptbook can do\",\n                    ],\n                },\n                {\n                    id: 'urgency',\n                    question: 'When would you like to start?',\n                    type: 'single',\n                    options: [\n                        'As soon as possible, this is urgent',\n                        'Next quarter',\n                        \"We're just exploring options for now\",\n                    ],\n                },\n                {\n                    id: 'contact',\n                    question: 'Where should we reach you?',\n                    subtitle: 'Jiri will call you within 24 hours.',\n                    type: 'contact',\n                    fields: [\n                        { id: 'name', label: 'Name', type: 'text', placeholder: 'Jane Smith' },\n                        { id: 'company', label: 'Company', type: 'text', placeholder: 'Your company name' },\n                        { id: 'email', label: 'Email', type: 'email', placeholder: 'jane@company.com' },\n                        { id: 'phone', label: 'Phone', type: 'tel', placeholder: '+1 555 123 4567', inputMode: 'tel' },\n                    ],\n                },\n            ],\n            successTitle: (name) => `Thanks, ${name}!`,\n            successDescription: (\n                <>\n                    <strong className=\"text-[#0f172a]\">Jiri</strong> will call you within 24 hours. We&apos;ll go\n                    through your questions and set a time for a video call.\n                </>\n            ),\n            successEmailPrefix: \"We'll send the video call link to\",\n            close: 'Close',\n            stepLabel: (currentStep, totalSteps) => `Step ${currentStep + 1} of ${totalSteps}`,\n            remainingSpots: '3 spots left',\n            intro: \"4 questions, 30 seconds.
