Ověříme, jestli pro vás Promptbook dává smysl.',\n            submitting: 'Odesílám...',\n            submit: 'Rezervovat hovor zdarma',\n            back: 'Zpět',\n        },\n        bookingNotification: {\n            notifications: [\n                { company: 'Firma z Prahy', time: 'před 2 hodinami' },\n                { company: 'Firma z Brna', time: 'před 4 hodinami' },\n                { company: 'Firma z Ostravy', time: 'včera' },\n            ],\n            messageSuffix: 'si zarezervovala strategický hovor',\n        },\n    },\n    en: {\n        loading: 'Loading...',\n        header: {\n            fomoBefore: 'Only',\n            fomoStrong: '7 of 10 spots',\n            fomoAfter: 'left for a free strategy call',\n            ctaMobile: 'Free call',\n            ctaDesktop: 'Book a free call',\n        },\n        hero: {\n            eyebrow: 'Czech AI platform for company data',\n            heading: (\n                <>\n                    What if every\n                    <br />\n                    employee had{' '}\n                    <span className=\"bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0891b2] to-[#06b6d4] bg-clip-text text-transparent\">\n                        instant\n                        <br />\n                        access\n                    </span>{' '}\n                    to everything your\n                    <br />\n                    company has ever written?\n                </>\n            ),\n            description: (\n                <>\n                    Promptbook reads up to one million standard pages of your documents and answers anything. A new hire\n                    can ask, and so can a seasoned manager. Both get the same precise answer.\n                </>\n            ),\n            cta: 'I want a free strategy call',\n            badges: ['100% GDPR', 'Up to 1,000,000 standard pages', 'Czech platform'],\n            chatTitle: 'Promptbook - HR Assistant',\n            chatInputPlaceholder: 'Type a question...',\n            chatMessages: [\n                {\n                    id: 1,\n                    type: 'user',\n                    text: \"Hi, I just started here and I can't find how many vacation days I get. Can you help?\",\n                    startDelay: 0,\n                    static: true,\n                },\n                {\n                    id: 2,\n                    type: 'bot',\n                    text: 'Welcome to the company, Anna! According to the employee handbook, you get **25 vacation days per year**.',\n                    startDelay: 2000,\n                    static: false,\n                },\n                {\n                    id: 3,\n                    type: 'bot',\n                    text: \"I'll email it to you as well, so you have it handy. Anything else?\",\n                    startDelay: 1200,\n                    static: false,\n                },\n                {\n                    id: 4,\n                    type: 'user',\n                    text: 'Great, thanks! Exactly what I needed. 🙌',\n                    startDelay: 1000,\n                    static: false,\n                },\n            ],\n        },\n        socialProof: {\n            eyebrow: 'For companies that take their data seriously',\n            industries: [\n                'Manufacturing',\n                'Law firms',\n                'Construction',\n                'Public administration',\n                'Healthcare',\n                'Education',\n                'Logistics',\n                'Energy',\n                'IT',\n                'Insurance',\n                'Pharma',\n                'E-commerce',\n                'Accounting firms',\n                'Telecom',\n            ],\n        },\n        painPoints: {\n            eyebrow: 'Why companies lose millions',\n            heading: (\n                <>\n                    The knowledge is already in your company.{' '}\n                    <span className=\"bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0891b2] to-[#06b6d4] bg-clip-text text-transparent\">\n                        Nobody can find it.\n                    </span>\n                </>\n            ),\n            points: [\n                {\n                    title: 'Scattered company data',\n                    description:\n                        \"Policies on SharePoint, contracts in email, manuals on Google Drive, processes in people's heads. It all exists. It's just spread across dozens of systems.\",\n                    consequence: 'Employees search instead of doing the work you pay them for.',\n                },\n                {\n                    title: 'Key people as an internal help desk',\n                    description:\n                        'Senior people answer the same questions over and over, from newcomers and colleagues alike. Instead of strategic work, they run an information desk.',\n                    consequence: 'Your most expensive people are doing work a system should be doing.',\n                },\n                {\n                    title: 'Public AI risk',\n                    description:\n                        \"People paste work into public ChatGPT, sensitive company documents included. Public AI doesn't know your company. When it doesn't have the answer, it makes one up.\",\n                    consequence:\n                        'One decision based on invented information can cost more than your whole annual software budget.',\n                },\n                {\n                    title: 'Departing know-how',\n                    description:\n                        'When an experienced person leaves, they take knowledge nobody wrote down. How decisions get made, what each client has been through, why things are done this way.',\n                    consequence: \"The company loses years of experience, and you don't get that back quickly.\",\n                },\n            ],\n            timeAllocation: {\n                title: \"Where does your team's time go?\",\n                beforeLabel: 'Before',\n                beforePrimary: 'Busywork',\n                beforeSecondary: '20%',\n                beforeNote: 'Emails · Meetings · Routine tasks',\n                afterLabel: 'After deploying Promptbook',\n                afterPrimary: 'What matters',\n                afterSecondary: '20%',\n                afterNote: 'Family · Creativity · Strategic work',\n            },\n        },\n        solution: {\n            eyebrow: 'Solution',\n            heading: (\n                <>\n                    A virtual employee who{' '}\n                    <span className=\"bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0891b2] to-[#06b6d4] bg-clip-text text-transparent\">\n                        knows the whole company.\n                    </span>\n                </>\n            ),\n            description:\n                'Upload your company documents into a secure vault. Promptbook turns them into a virtual employee: an HR specialist, a lawyer, a technician. Then anyone can just ask, in plain language.',\n            benefits: [\n                {\n                    title: 'No prompting',\n                    description:\n                        'No training. No \"write the prompt like an IT person would\". Your people are experts in their field, not in casting spells on robots. They ask, by text or by voice, and they get an answer.',\n                    highlight: 'The same way they talk to a colleague.',\n                },\n                {\n                    title: 'Context vault',\n                    description:\n                        \"Data never leaves your infrastructure. We don't use it to train any models. Do you know what happens when an employee pastes an NDA into public ChatGPT?\",\n                    highlight: \"We do. That's why we built it differently.\",\n                },\n                {\n                    title: '\"I don\\'t know\" beats a hallucination',\n                    description:\n                        \"Public AI invents five paragraphs that sound convincing. They can cost you the company. Promptbook draws only from your data. And when it can't find the answer?\",\n                    highlight: 'It says it straight: \"I don\\'t have that information in your documents.\"',\n                },\n            ],\n        },\n        howItWorks: {\n            eyebrow: 'How it works',\n            heading: (\n                <>\n                    Deployment{' '}\n                    <span className=\"bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0891b2] to-[#06b6d4] bg-clip-text text-transparent\">\n                        without the pain.\n                    </span>\n                </>\n            ),\n            steps: [\n                {\n                    title: 'Upload documents',\n                    description:\n                        'Policies, contracts, manuals, NDAs, meeting notes. Anything sitting today in SharePoint, on Google Drive, or in a desk drawer. Promptbook handles up to one million standard pages.',\n                },\n                {\n                    title: 'Create a virtual employee',\n                    description:\n                        'An HR specialist who knows the employee handbook. A lawyer who knows every contract. A technician who knows the manuals. Each agent answers strictly from your company data.',\n                },\n                {\n                    title: 'People ask questions',\n                    description:\n                        'In plain language. Like sending a WhatsApp message. Or a voice note. No prompts, no training, no IT department.',\n                },\n            ],\n            cta: 'I want to see how it works',\n        },\n        enemy: {\n            eyebrow: 'Why not public ChatGPT',\n            heading: (\n                <>\n                    &quot;I&apos;ll just paste it into ChatGPT&quot;{' '}\n                    <span className=\"bg-gradient-to-r from-red-500 to-rose-500 bg-clip-text text-transparent\">\n                        is corporate self-sabotage.\n                    </span>\n                </>\n            ),\n            chatgptLabel: 'Public ChatGPT',\n            promptbookLabel: 'Promptbook',\n            comparisons: [\n                {\n                    feature: \"When it doesn't know\",\n                    chatgpt: 'Confidently invents one',\n                    promptbook: 'Says: \"I don\\'t know\"',\n                },\n                {\n                    feature: 'Your company data',\n                    chatgpt: 'Public cloud. Who knows who reads it',\n                    promptbook: 'Locked in your vault',\n                },\n                {\n                    feature: 'Training on your data',\n                    chatgpt: 'Yes, it trains other models on it',\n                    promptbook: 'No. Never.',\n                },\n                {\n                    feature: 'How you ask',\n                    chatgpt: '\"Act as senior lawyer, temperature 0.2...\"',\n                    promptbook: '\"Hey, where\\'s that NDA from 2021?\"',\n                },\n                {\n                    feature: 'Company context',\n                    chatgpt: 'None. It knows nothing about your company',\n                    promptbook: 'It knows your policies, contracts, processes',\n                },\n            ],\n        },\n        testimonials: {\n            eyebrow: 'Testimonials',\n            heading: (\n                <>\n                    What companies say once they{' '}\n                    <span className=\"bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0891b2] to-[#06b6d4] bg-clip-text text-transparent\">\n                        stop searching.\n                    </span>\n                </>\n            ),\n            items: [\n                {\n                    quote: \"Promptbook didn't cut us off from each other. The opposite. We finally have time for the real work we're paid to do.\",\n                    author: 'IT department',\n                    company: 'Silesian University in Opava',\n                },\n                {\n                    quote: \"Newcomers aren't afraid to ask anymore. They get answers right away, straight from our internal policies.\",\n                    author: 'Municipal district',\n                    company: 'Prague 13',\n                },\n            ],\n            metrics: [\n                { value: '1,000,000', label: 'standard pages of capacity', suffix: '' },\n                { value: '100%', label: 'GDPR compliant', suffix: '' },\n                { value: '0', label: 'hallucinations', suffix: '' },\n            ],\n        },\n        team: {\n            title: \"Who's behind this\",\n            description: (\n                <>\n                    We help companies use AI practically and safely. Our backgrounds are in research, development, and\n                    business.\n                </>\n            ),\n            jiriDescription: (\n                <>\n                    Ph.D. in Mathematics, former researcher at{' '}\n                    <Link href=\"https://www.it4i.cz/\">IT4I National Supercomputing Centre</Link>.\n                </>\n            ),\n            pavolDescription: (\n                <>\n                    One of the top <Link href=\"https://www.pavolhejny.com/\">open-source contributors</Link> in Czechia.\n                    Developer with 15+ years of experience.\n                </>\n            ),\n        },\n        finalCta: {\n            heading: (\n                <>\n                    Stop paying people to search.\n                    <br />\n                    Start paying them to work.\n                </>\n            ),\n            description:\n                \"Book a 20-minute strategy call with our team. No hard sell. We'll go through your situation and show you Promptbook running on your own data.\",\n            cta: 'Book a free strategy call',\n            capacityPrefix: 'Booked',\n            capacityStrong: '7',\n            capacitySuffix: 'of 10 spots',\n            capacityRemaining: '3 left',\n            capacityNote: 'We take on 10 companies a month at most, so we have time for each one.',\n            riskReversal:\n                \"Even if you never buy Promptbook, you'll walk away with a concrete plan for sorting out the chaos in your company data.\",\n        },\n        qualificationPopup: {\n            dialogTitle: 'Qualification form',\n            questions: [\n                {\n                    id: 'industry',\n                    question: 'What industry are you in?',\n                    type: 'single',\n                    options: [\n                        'Manufacturing / Industry',\n                        'Legal / Finance',\n                        'Construction /    },\n                {\n                    id: 'pain_point',\n                    question: \"What's your biggest headache?\",\n                    type: 'single',\n                    options: [\n                        'People spend hours searching for documents',\n                        'Senior people answer the same questions again and again',\n                        'Company data in public ChatGPT worries us',\n                        'When a key person leaves, know-how leaves with them',\n                        \"I'm just exploring what Promptbook can do\",\n                    ],\n                },\n                {\n                    id: 'urgency',\n                    question: 'When would you like to start?',\n                    type: 'single',\n                    options: [\n                        'As soon as possible, this is urgent',\n                        'Next quarter',\n                        \"We're just exploring options for now\",\n className=\"mt-0.5\"\n                                />\n                                <label htmlFor=\"consent\" className=\"text-sm text-gray-400 leading-relaxed\">\n '/ai-ta-krajta',\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_MEDIA_KIT_PATH,\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_BRANDING_PATH,\n    '/hackathon-factory',\n    '/cs/online-workshop',\n    '/cs/komunita/clenstvi',\n    '/cs/pavol',\n    '/en/pavol',\n    '/cs/ochrana-osobnich-udaju',\n    '/en/privacy-policy',\n    '/cs/obchodni-podminky',\n    '/en/terms-and-conditions',\n    '/contact',\n    '/branding',\n    '/data-deletion',\n    '/old',\n] as const;\n\ntype PublicPagePath = (typeof PUBLIC_PAGE_PATHS)[number];\n\n/**\n * The address which used to hold the training and now only forwards to the workshop it became\n */\nconst RETIRED_TRAINING_PATH = '/skoleni';\n\n/**\n * A public address which renders nothing itself and only forwards to a page of this suite.\n *\n * Note: A route reading `Accept-Language` may pick any of its localized destinations, so every one of them is\n *       accepted and every one of them is rendered by its own page check above.\n */\ntype PublicRedirect = {\n    readonly path: string;\n    readonly statusCode: number;\n    readonly destinationPaths: readonly PublicPagePath[];\n};\n\nconst PERMANENT_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE = 308;\nconst TEMPORARY_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE = 307;\n\nconst PUBLIC_REDIRECTS: readonly PublicRedirect[] = [\n    { path: '/', statusCode: TEMPORARY_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE, destinationPaths: ['/cs', '/en'] },\n    { path: '/pavol', statusCode: TEMPORARY_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE, destinationPaths: ['/cs/pavol', '/en/pavol'] },\n    {\n        path: '/privacy',\n        statusCode: TEMPORARY_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE,\n        destinationPaths: ['/cs/ochrana-osobnich-udaju', '/en/privacy-policy'],\n    },\n    {\n        path: '/terms',\n        statusCode: TEMPORARY_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE,\n        destinationPaths: ['/cs/obchodni-podminky', '/en/terms-and-conditions'],\n    },\n    {\n        path: RETIRED_TRAINING_PATH,\n        statusCode: PERMANENT_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE,\n        destinationPaths: [AI_SUPERVIZE_MINI_PATH],\n    },\n];\n\nconst E2E_DISCOUNT_CODE = 'E2E SLEVA';\n\nconst PUBLIC_PAGE_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 180_000;\n\nasync function expectPublicPageToLoad(page: Page, path: PublicPagePath): Promise<void> {\n    const response = await page.goto(path, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });\n\n    expect(response, `Expected ${path} to produce a document response`).not.toBeNull();\n    expect(response!.ok(), `Expected ${path} to load without a server error`).toBeTruthy();\n    await expect(\n        page.locator('main, h1, footer').first(),\n        `Expected ${path} to render visible page content`,\n    ).toBeVisible();\n}\n\n/**\n * Reads where a redirect points, whether it answers with an absolute or a site-relative `Location`.\n */\nfunction readRedirectDestinationPath(locationHeader: string, requestUrl: string): string {\n    const destinationUrl = new URL(locationHeader, requestUrl);\n\n    return `${destinationUrl.pathname}${destinationUrl.search}${destinationUrl.hash}`;\n}\n\n/**\n * Asks a redirecting address where it points without following it, so the destination is rendered once by the page\n * check which owns it instead of a second time through every address leading to it.\n */\nasync function readRedirectDestination(\n    request: APIRequestContext,\n    path: string,\n    expectedStatusCode: number,\n): Promise<string> {\n    const response = await request.get(path, { maxRedirects: 0 });\n\n    expect(response.status(), `Expected ${path} to answer with status ${expectedStatusCode}`).toBe(expectedStatusCode);\n\n    const locationHeader = response.headers()['location'];\n    expect(locationHeader, `Expected ${path} to name where it redirects`).toBeDefined();\n\n    return readRedirectDestinationPath(locationHeader, response.url());\n}\n\nfor (const path of PUBLIC_PAGE_PATHS) {\n    // Next.js compiles a route on its first dev-server visit. Isolating every route keeps earlier cold compilations\n    // from exhausting the timeout of a healthy page later in the smoke suite.\n    test(`public landing and information page loads: ${path}`, async ({ page }) => {\n        await expectPublicPageToLoad(page, path);\n    });\n}\n\ntest('AI ta Krajta collaboration section deep-links to its media kit', async ({ page }) => {\n    await page.goto(AI_TA_KRAJTA_PATH, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });\n\n    const mediaKitLink = page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Otevřít media kit' });\n    await expect(mediaKitLink).toHaveAttribute('href', AI_TA_KRAJTA_MEDIA_KIT_PATH);\n    await mediaKitLink.click();\n\n    await expect(page).toHaveURL(AI_TA_KRAJTA_MEDIA_KIT_PATH);\n    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: /Oslovte české a slovenské publikum/i })).toBeVisible();\n});\n\ntest('AI ta Krajta owns its metadata, icon and installable manifest and credits Promptbook coder', async ({ page }) => {\n    await page.goto(AI_TA_KRAJTA_PATH, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });\n    await expect(page.locator('footer')).toBeVisible();\n    await expect(page).toHaveTitle(`${AI_TA_KRAJTA_BRAND_NAME} | Český podcast o umělé inteligenci`);\n\n    const metadataIdentity = await page.evaluate(\n        ({ scalableIconPath, rasterIconPath, manifestPath, rssFeedMediaType, rssFeedUrl, rssFeedLabel }) => {\n            const identityTags = Array.from(document.head.querySelectorAll('meta, link'));\n            const structuredDataNodes = Array.from(document.head.querySelectorAll('script[type*=ld]'));\n            const footerText = document.querySelector('footer')?.textContent ?? '';\n\n            const isPromptbookIdentityAbsent = identityTags\n                .filter((element) => /application-name|creator|publisher|og:site_name|twitter:site/.test(element.outerHTML))\n                .every((element) => !element.outerHTML.includes('Promptbook'));\n            const isPromptbookStructuredDataAbsent = structuredDataNodes.every(\n                (element) => !(element.textContent ?? '').includes('Promptbook'),\n            );\n            const isPodcastIconUsed = identityTags.some(\n                (element) =>\n                    element.getAttribute('rel') === 'icon' && element.getAttribute('href') === scalableIconPath,\n            );\n            const isPodcastTouchIconUsed = identityTags.some(\n                (element) =>\n                    element.getAttribute('rel') === 'apple-touch-icon' &&\n                    element.getAttribute('href') === rasterIconPath,\n            );\n            const isPodcastManifestUsed = identityTags.some(\n                (element) => element.getAttribute('rel') === 'manifest' && element.getAttribute('href') === manifestPath,\n            );\n            const isPodcastRssFeedAdvertised = identityTags.some(\n                (element) =>\n                    element.getAttribute('rel') === 'alternate' &&\n                    element.getAttribute('type') === rssFeedMediaType &&\n                    element.getAttribute('href') === rssFeedUrl,\n            );\n            const isPodcastRssFeedLinked = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a')).some(\n                (element) => element.textContent?.trim() === rssFeedLabel && element.getAttribute('href') === rssFeedUrl,\n            );\n            const isLegalCompanyPresent = footerText.includes('AI Web s.r.o.');\n\n            return {\n                isPromptbookIdentityAbsent,\n                isPromptbookStructuredDataAbsent,\n                isPodcastIconUsed,\n                isPodcastTouchIconUsed,\n                isPodcastManifestUsed,\n                isPodcastRssFeedAdvertised,\n                isPodcastRssFeedLinked,\n                isLegalCompanyPresent,\n            };\n        },\n        {\n            scalableIconPath: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.SCALABLE.path,\n            rasterIconPath: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.RASTER.path,\n            manifestPath: AI_TA_KRAJTA_MANIFEST_PATH,\n            rssFeedMediaType: AI_TA_KRAJTA_RSS_FEED_MEDIA_TYPE,\n            rssFeedUrl: AI_TA_KRAJTA_RSS_FEED_PLATFORM.url,\n            rssFeedLabel: AI_TA_KRAJTA_RSS_FEED_PLATFORM.label,\n        },\n    );\n\n    expect(metadataIdentity).toEqual({\n        isPromptbookIdentityAbsent: true,\n        isPromptbookStructuredDataAbsent: true,\n        isPodcastIconUsed: true,\n        isPodcastTouchIconUsed: true,\n        isPodcastManifestUsed: true,\n        isPodcastRssFeedAdvertised: true,\n        isPodcastRssFeedLinked: true,\n        isLegalCompanyPresent: true,\n    });\n\n    await expect(page.locator('footer').getByRole('link', { name: 'Done by Promptbook coder', exact: true }))\n        .toHaveAttribute('href', 'https://coder.ptbk.io/');\n\n    const manifestResponse = await page.request.get(AI_TA_KRAJTA_MANIFEST_PATH);\n\n    expect(manifestResponse.ok()).toBeTruthy();\n    expect(await manifestResponse.json()).toMatchObject({\n        name: AI_TA_KRAJTA_BRAND_NAME,\n        short_name: AI_TA_KRAJTA_BRAND_NAME,\n        icons: [\n            { src: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.SCALABLE.path, purpose: 'any' },\n            { src: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.RASTER.path, purpose: 'any' },\n            { src: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.RASTER.path, purpose: 'maskable' },\n        ],\n    });\n\n    for (const appIcon of [AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.SCALABLE, AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.RASTER]) {\n        const iconResponse = await page.request.get(appIcon.path);\n\n        expect(iconResponse.ok(), `Expected ${appIcon.path} to be served`).toBeTruthy();\n        expect(iconResponse.headers()['content-type']).toContain(appIcon.type);\n    }\n});\n\ntest('AI ta Krajta searches complete transcripts on the server without sending them to the browser', async ({ page, request }) => {\n    const transcriptSearchResponse = await request.get(\n        `${AI_TA_KRAJTA_EPISODE_SEARCH_API_PATH}?${new URLSearchParams({ search: 'zahradníkem' }).toString()}`,\n    );\n    const transcriptSearchResponseText = await transcriptSearchResponse.text();\n\n    expect(transcriptSearchResponse.ok()).toBeTruthy();\n    expect(JSON.parse(transcriptSearchResponseText)).toMatchObject({ episodeSlugs: expect.arrayContaining(['65']) });\n    expect(transcriptSearchResponseText).not.toContain('Kozel za hradníkem');\n\n    await page.goto(AI_TA_KRAJTA_PATH, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });\n    await page.getByRole('searchbox', { name: 'Hledat v dílech' }).fill('zahradníkem');\n\n    await `${RETIRED_TRAINING_PATH}?${DISCOUNT_CODE_QUERY_PARAMETER}=${encodeURIComponent(E2E_DISCOUNT_CODE)}`,\n        PERMANENT_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE,\n    );\n\n    expect(destinationPath, `Expected );\n});\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":19,"oldLines":6,"newStart":19,"newLines":7,"lines":[" const PUBLIC_PAGE_PATHS = [","     '/cs',","     '/en',","+    PRO_FIRMY_PATH,","     '/pro-mesta',"," AI_SUPERVIZE_MINI_PATH, createDiscountCodePrefillPath } from '@/lib/discounts/discountPlaces';\nimport {\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS,\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_BRAND_NAME,\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_BRANDING_PATH,\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_EPISODE_SEARCH_API_PATH,\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_MANIFEST_PATH,\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_MEDIA_KIT_PATH,\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_PATH,\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_RSS_FEED_MEDIA_TYPE,\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_RSS_FEED_PLATFORM,\n} from '@/businesses/ai-ta-krajta/config';\nimport { expect, test, type APIRequestContext, type Page } from '@playwright/test';\n\n/**\n * Every public address which renders a page of its own.\n */\nconst PUBLIC_PAGE_PATHS = [\n    '/cs',\n    '/en',\n    PRO_FIRMY_PATH,\n    '/pro-mesta',\n    '/for-agro',\n    '/for-industry',\n    '/ai-supervize',\n    AI_SUPERVIZE_MINI_PATH,\n    // '/ai-supervize-mini',\n    '/ai-ta-krajta',\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_MEDIA_KIT_PATH,\n    AI_TA_KRAJTA_BRANDING_PATH,\n    '/hackathon-factory',\n    '/cs/online-workshop',\n    '/cs/komunita/clenstvi',\n    '/cs/pavol',\n    '/en/pavol',\n    '/cs/ochrana-osobnich-udaju',\n    '/en/privacy-policy',\n    '/cs/obchodni-podminky',\n    '/en/terms-and-conditions',\n    '/contact',\n    '/branding',\n    '/data-deletion',\n    '/old',\n] as const;\n\ntype PublicPagePath = (typeof PUBLIC_PAGE_PATHS)[number];\n\n/**\n * The address which used to hold the training and now only forwards to the workshop it became\n */\nconst RETIRED_TRAINING_PATH = '/skoleni';\n\n/**\n * A public address which renders nothing itself and only forwards to a page of this suite.\n *\n * Note: A route reading `Accept-Language` may pick any of its localized destinations, so every one of them is\n *       accepted and every one of them is rendered by its own page check above.\n */\ntype PublicRedirect = {\n    readonly path: string;\n    readonly statusCode: number;\n    readonly destinationPaths: readonly PublicPagePath[];\n};\n\nconst PERMANENT_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE = 308;\nconst TEMPORARY_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE = 307;\n\nconst PUBLIC_REDIRECTS: readonly PublicRedirect[] = [\n    { path: '/', statusCode: TEMPORARY_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE, destinationPaths: ['/cs', '/en'] },\n    { path: '/pavol', statusCode: TEMPORARY_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE, destinationPaths: ['/cs/pavol', '/en/pavol'] },\n    {\n        path: '/privacy',\n        statusCode: TEMPORARY_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE,\n        destinationPaths: ['/cs/ochrana-osobnich-udaju', '/en/privacy-policy'],\n    },\n    {\n        path: '/terms',\n        statusCode: TEMPORARY_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE,\n        destinationPaths: ['/cs/obchodni-podminky', '/en/terms-and-conditions'],\n    },\n    {\n        path: RETIRED_TRAINING_PATH,\n        statusCode: PERMANENT_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE,\n        destinationPaths: [AI_SUPERVIZE_MINI_PATH],\n    },\n];\n\nconst E2E_DISCOUNT_CODE = 'E2E SLEVA';\n\nconst PUBLIC_PAGE_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 180_000;\n\nasync function expectPublicPageToLoad(page: Page, path: PublicPagePath): Promise<void> {\n    const response = await page.goto(path, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });\n\n    expect(response, `Expected ${path} to produce a document response`).not.toBeNull();\n    expect(response!.ok(), `Expected ${path} to load without a server error`).toBeTruthy();\n    await expect(\n        page.locator('main, h1, footer').first(),\n        `Expected ${path} to render visible page content`,\n    ).toBeVisible();\n}\n\n/**\n * Reads where a redirect points, whether it answers with an absolute or a site-relative `Location`.\n */\nfunction readRedirectDestinationPath(locationHeader: string, requestUrl: string): string {\n    const destinationUrl = new URL(locationHeader, requestUrl);\n\n    return `${destinationUrl.pathname}${destinationUrl.search}${destinationUrl.hash}`;\n}\n\n/**\n * Asks a redirecting address where it points without following it, so the destination is rendered once by the page\n * check which owns it instead of a second time through every address leading to it.\n */\nasync function readRedirectDestination(\n    request: APIRequestContext,\n    path: string,\n    expectedStatusCode: number,\n): Promise<string> {\n    const response = await request.get(path, { maxRedirects: 0 });\n\n    expect(response.status(), `Expected ${path} to answer with status ${expectedStatusCode}`).toBe(expectedStatusCode);\n\n    const locationHeader = response.headers()['location'];\n    expect(locationHeader, `Expected ${path} to name where it redirects`).toBeDefined();\n\n    return readRedirectDestinationPath(locationHeader, response.url());\n}\n\nfor (const path of PUBLIC_PAGE_PATHS) {\n    // Next.js compiles a route on its first dev-server visit. Isolating every route keeps earlier cold compilations\n    // from exhausting the timeout of a healthy page later in the smoke suite.\n    test(`public landing and information page loads: ${path}`, async ({ page }) => {\n        await expectPublicPageToLoad(page, path);\n    });\n}\n\ntest('AI ta Krajta collaboration section deep-links to its media kit', async ({ page }) => {\n    await page.goto(AI_TA_KRAJTA_PATH, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });\n\n    const mediaKitLink = page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Otevřít media kit' });\n    await expect(mediaKitLink).toHaveAttribute('href', AI_TA_KRAJTA_MEDIA_KIT_PATH);\n    await mediaKitLink.click();\n\n    await expect(page).toHaveURL(AI_TA_KRAJTA_MEDIA_KIT_PATH);\n    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: /Oslovte české a slovenské publikum/i })).toBeVisible();\n});\n\ntest('AI ta Krajta owns its metadata, icon and installable manifest and credits Promptbook coder', async ({ page }) => {\n    await page.goto(AI_TA_KRAJTA_PATH, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });\n    await expect(page.locator('footer')).toBeVisible();\n    await expect(page).toHaveTitle(`${AI_TA_KRAJTA_BRAND_NAME} | Český podcast o umělé inteligenci`);\n\n    const metadataIdentity = await page.evaluate(\n        ({ scalableIconPath, rasterIconPath, manifestPath, rssFeedMediaType, rssFeedUrl, rssFeedLabel }) => {\n            const identityTags = Array.from(document.head.querySelectorAll('meta, link'));\n            const structuredDataNodes = Array.from(document.head.querySelectorAll('script[type*=ld]'));\n            const footerText = document.querySelector('footer')?.textContent ?? '';\n\n            const isPromptbookIdentityAbsent = identityTags\n                .filter((element) => /application-name|creator|publisher|og:site_name|twitter:site/.test(element.outerHTML))\n                .every((element) => !element.outerHTML.includes('Promptbook'));\n            const isPromptbookStructuredDataAbsent = structuredDataNodes.every(\n                (element) => !(element.textContent ?? '').includes('Promptbook'),\n            );\n            const isPodcastIconUsed = identityTags.some(\n                (element) =>\n                    element.getAttribute('rel') === 'icon' && element.getAttribute('href') === scalableIconPath,\n            );\n            const isPodcastTouchIconUsed = identityTags.some(\n                (element) =>\n                    element.getAttribute('rel') === 'apple-touch-icon' &&\n                    element.getAttribute('href') === rasterIconPath,\n            );\n            const isPodcastManifestUsed = identityTags.some(\n                (element) => element.getAttribute('rel') === 'manifest' && element.getAttribute('href') === manifestPath,\n            );\n            const isPodcastRssFeedAdvertised = identityTags.some(\n                (element) =>\n                    element.getAttribute('rel') === 'alternate' &&\n                    element.getAttribute('type') === rssFeedMediaType &&\n                    element.getAttribute('href') === rssFeedUrl,\n            );\n            const isPodcastRssFeedLinked = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a')).some(\n                (element) => element.textContent?.trim() === rssFeedLabel && element.getAttribute('href') === rssFeedUrl,\n            );\n            const isLegalCompanyPresent = footerText.includes('AI Web s.r.o.');\n\n            return {\n                isPromptbookIdentityAbsent,\n                isPromptbookStructuredDataAbsent,\n                isPodcastIconUsed,\n                isPodcastTouchIconUsed,\n                isPodcastManifestUsed,\n                isPodcastRssFeedAdvertised,\n                isPodcastRssFeedLinked,\n                isLegalCompanyPresent,\n            };\n        },\n        {\n            scalableIconPath: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.SCALABLE.path,\n            rasterIconPath: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.RASTER.path,\n            manifestPath: AI_TA_KRAJTA_MANIFEST_PATH,\n            rssFeedMediaType: AI_TA_KRAJTA_RSS_FEED_MEDIA_TYPE,\n            rssFeedUrl: AI_TA_KRAJTA_RSS_FEED_PLATFORM.url,\n            rssFeedLabel: AI_TA_KRAJTA_RSS_FEED_PLATFORM.label,\n        },\n    );\n\n    expect(metadataIdentity).toEqual({\n        isPromptbookIdentityAbsent: true,\n        isPromptbookStructuredDataAbsent: true,\n        isPodcastIconUsed: true,\n        isPodcastTouchIconUsed: true,\n        isPodcastManifestUsed: true,\n        isPodcastRssFeedAdvertised: true,\n        isPodcastRssFeedLinked: true,\n        isLegalCompanyPresent: true,\n    });\n\n    await expect(page.locator('footer').getByRole('link', { name: 'Done by Promptbook coder', exact: true }))\n        .toHaveAttribute('href', 'https://coder.ptbk.io/');\n\n    const manifestResponse = await page.request.get(AI_TA_KRAJTA_MANIFEST_PATH);\n\n    expect(manifestResponse.ok()).toBeTruthy();\n    expect(await manifestResponse.json()).toMatchObject({\n        name: AI_TA_KRAJTA_BRAND_NAME,\n        short_name: AI_TA_KRAJTA_BRAND_NAME,\n        icons: [\n            { src: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.SCALABLE.path, purpose: 'any' },\n            { src: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.RASTER.path, purpose: 'any' },\n            { src: AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.RASTER.path, purpose: 'maskable' },\n        ],\n    });\n\n    for (const appIcon of [AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.SCALABLE, AI_TA_KRAJTA_APP_ICONS.RASTER]) {\n        const iconResponse = await page.request.get(appIcon.path);\n\n        expect(iconResponse.ok(), `Expected ${appIcon.path} to be served`).toBeTruthy();\n        expect(iconResponse.headers()['content-type']).toContain(appIcon.type);\n    }\n});\n\ntest('AI ta Krajta searches complete transcripts on the server without sending them to the browser', async ({ page, request }) => {\n    const transcriptSearchResponse = await request.get(\n        `${AI_TA_KRAJTA_EPISODE_SEARCH_API_PATH}?${new URLSearchParams({ search: 'zahradníkem' }).toString()}`,\n    );\n    const transcriptSearchResponseText = await transcriptSearchResponse.text();\n\n    expect(transcriptSearchResponse.ok()).toBeTruthy();\n    expect(JSON.parse(transcriptSearchResponseText)).toMatchObject({ episodeSlugs: expect.arrayContaining(['65']) });\n    expect(transcriptSearchResponseText).not.toContain('Kozel za hradníkem');\n\n    await page.goto(AI_TA_KRAJTA_PATH, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });\n    await page.getByRole('searchbox', { name: 'Hledat v dílech' }).fill('zahradníkem');\n\n    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: /AI zrychlí vývoj 10x/ })).toBeVisible();\n    await expect(page.locator('body')).not.toContainText('Kozel za hradníkem');\n});\n\nfor (const publicRedirect of PUBLIC_REDIRECTS) {\n    test(`public address redirects to its page: ${publicRedirect.path}`, async ({ request }) => {\n        test.setTimeout(PUBLIC_PAGE_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS);\n\n        const destinationPath = await readRedirectDestination(request, publicRedirect.path, publicRedirect.statusCode);\n\n        expect(\n            publicRedirect.destinationPaths.some((candidatePath) => candidatePath === destinationPath),\n            `Expected ${publicRedirect.path} to redirect to ${publicRedirect.destinationPaths.join(\n                ' or ',\n            )}, but it pointed at ${destinationPath}`,\n        ).toBeTruthy();\n    });\n}\n\ntest(`${RETIRED_TRAINING_PATH} carries a discount code to the workshop registration`, async ({ request }) => {\n    test.setTimeout(PUBLIC_PAGE_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS);\n\n    const destinationPath = await readRedirectDestination(\n        request,\n        `${RETIRED_TRAINING_PATH}?${DISCOUNT_CODE_QUERY_PARAMETER}=${encodeURIComponent(E2E_DISCOUNT_CODE)}`,\n        PERMANENT_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE,\n    );\n\n    expect(destinationPath, `Expected ${RETIRED_TRAINING_PATH} to pre-fill the discount code it was given`).toBe(\n        createDiscountCodePrefillPath(AI_SUPERVIZE_MINI_PATH, REGISTRATION_SECTION_ID, E2E_DISCOUNT_CODE),\n    );\n});\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":11,"oldLines":6,"newStart":11,"newLines":7,"lines":["     AI_TA_KRAJTA_RSS_FEED_MEDIA_TYPE,","     AI_TA_KRAJTA_RSS_FEED_PLATFORM,"," } from   PRO_FIRMY_PATH,\n    '/pro-mesta',\n    '/for-agro',\n    '/for-industry',\n    '/ai-supervize',\n    AI_SUPERVIZE_MINI_PATH,\n    // '/ai-supervize-mini',\n    '/ai-ta-krajta',\n '/en/terms-and-conditions'],\n    },\n    {\n        path: RETIRED_TRAINING_PATH,\n        statusCode: PERMANENT_REDIRECT_STATUS_CODE,\n        destinationPaths: [AI_SUPERVIZE_MINI_PATH],\n    },\n];\n\nconst E2E_DISCOUNT_CODE = 'E2E SLEVA';\n\nconst PUBLIC_PAGE_TEST_TIMEOUT_MS = 180_000;\n\nasync function expectPublicPageToLoad(page: Page, path: PublicPagePath): Promise<void> {\n    const ).toBeVisible();\n}\n\n/**\n * Reads where a redirect points, whether it answers with an absolute or a site-relative `Location`.\n */\nfunction readRedirectDestinationPath(locationHeader: string, requestUrl: string): string {\n    const destinationUrl = new URL(locationHeader, requestUrl);\n\n    return `${destinationUrl.pathname}${destinationUrl.search}${destinationUrl.hash}`;\n}\n\n/**\n * response.headers()['location'];\n    expect(locationHeader, `Expected ${path} to name where it redirects`).toBeDefined();\n\n    return readRedirectDestinationPath(locationHeader, response.url());\n}\n\nfor (const path of PUBLIC_PAGE_PATHS) {\n    // Next.js compiles a route on its first dev-server visit. Isolating every route keeps earlier cold compilations\n    // from exhausting the timeout of a healthy page later in the smoke suite.\n    test(`public landing and information page loads: ${path}`, async ({ page }) => {\n        await expectPublicPageToLoad(page, path);\n    });\n}\n\ntest('AI ta Krajta collaboration section deep-links to its media kit', async ({ page }) => {\n    await page.goto(AI_TA_KRAJTA_PATH, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });\n\n    const mediaKitLink = page.getByRole('link', { name: 'Otevřít media kit' });\n    await expect(mediaKitLink).toHaveAttribute('href', AI_TA_KRAJTA_MEDIA_KIT_PATH);\n    await mediaKitLink.click();\n\n    await expect(page).toHaveURL(AI_TA_KRAJTA_MEDIA_KIT_PATH);\n    await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { name: /Oslovte české a slovenské publikum/i })).toBeVisible();\n});\n\ntest('AI ta Krajta owns its metadata, icon and installable manifest and credits Promptbook coder', async ({ page }) => {\n    await page.goto(AI_TA_KRAJTA_PATH, { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded' });\n    await expect(page.locator('footer')).toBeVisible();\n    await expect(page).toHaveTitle(`${AI_TA_KRAJTA_BRAND_NAME} | Český podcast o umělé inteligenci`);\n\n    const metadataIdentity = await page.evaluate(\n        ({ scalableIconPath, rasterIconPath, manifestPath, rssFeedMediaType, rssFeedUrl, rssFeedLabel }) => {\n            const identityTags = Array.from(document.head.querySelectorAll('meta, link'));\n            const structuredDataNodes = Array.from(document.head.querySelectorAll('script[type*=ld]'));\n            const footerText = document.querySelector('footer')?.textContent ??
